findings.title: Referral links are minted on a domain the app doesn't use anywhere else (tegridy.farm)
findings.evidence: ReferralWidget.tsx:71 `const referralLink = \`https://tegridy.farm/?ref=${encodeURIComponent(address)}\`;` and :94 truncated display. The canonical site URL everywhere else is different: usePageTitle.ts:4 `const SITE_URL = 'https://tegridyfarms.vercel.app'`, index.html:28 canonical, TransactionReceipt.tsx:231 falls back to a THIRD domain `https://tegridyfarms.io`, and usePoints.ts:129 builds referral links from `window.location.origin + '/swap?ref='`. Verified inconsistency across 4 surfaces; whether tegridy.farm is owned/aliased is unverified from code, but if it is not, every referral link shared from the home page dead-ends. Related funnel leak: the ?ref= param is only consumed by ReferralWidget, which mounts only when CONNECTED on Home (HomePage.tsx:452), and the 'Buy TOWELI' Link to="/swap" drops the query string — a referred visitor who clicks Buy before connecting loses the attribution.
findings.suggestion: Single source of truth for the share origin (window.location.origin or the SITE_URL constant); persist ?ref= (sessionStorage) on first load so attribution survives navigation/connect ordering; unify with usePoints' /swap?ref= scheme.

findings.title: YieldCalculator parses the comma-formatted APR display string, violating usePoolData's documented contract — projections silently wrong/inconsistent with the hero pill
findings.evidence: usePoolData.ts:50-52: "Consumers MUST use this [aprNum], not parseFloat(apr): once apr >= 10000 the display string is comma-formatted ('28,567') and parseFloat would silently truncate". YieldCalculator.tsx:70 does `const liveApr = Number(poolData.apr);`. At today's bootstrap TVL (APR >= 10,000%), Number('28,567') = NaN, so aprIsLive=false and the calculator labels itself 'Baseline 12% APR' while the hero stat pill on the SAME screen shows the real astronomic 'Base APR 28,567%' (HomePage.tsx:180) — direct on-screen contradiction. For APR between 1,000-9,999%, the calculator instead multiplies a bootstrap-inflated APR by up to 4.5x boost with no cap, because the intended guard never fires: usePoolData.ts:53 `const aprCapped = false;` is hardcoded, so YieldCalculator.tsx:72 `!poolData.aprCapped` is always true.
findings.suggestion: Use poolData.aprNum, and decide an explicit sanity ceiling for the calculator (e.g. fall back to baseline above N%), since aprCapped no longer exists as a real signal.

findings.title: index.html preloads three NON-hero images while the actual LCP hero art is not preloaded
findings.evidence: index.html:70-72 `<link rel="preload" as="image" href="/art/mfers-heaven.jpg">` + mumu-bull.jpg + bobowelie.jpg (166+143+185 = ~494 KB measured on disk). The real hero/LCP image is the home:0 art override → iph_0148 → /art/iphone/IMG_0148.jpg (artOverrides.ts:76, artConfig.ts:100), 268 KB / 2048x1448 measured, rendered full-viewport at HomePage.tsx:77-79. None of the three preloaded files is the hero: mfers-heaven appears below the fold in The Collection, bobowelie is the token logo. The stale preloads compete with the LCP fetch at highest priority. ArtImg (ArtImg.tsx:62-72) emits no fetchpriority, srcset, or sizes, so phones also download the full 2048px asset.
findings.suggestion: Preload /art/iphone/IMG_0148.jpg (ideally generated from the artOverrides map at build time so it can't go stale again), add fetchpriority="high" on the hero ArtImg, drop or demote the three stale preloads, and add responsive variants for the hero.

findings.title: Evergreen Security card claims 'bounty live', contradicting the 2026-06-11 honesty pass on the same page
findings.evidence: ProtocolStats.tsx:47 `{ l: 'Security', v: '82+', sub: 'findings resolved · bounty live', icon: '🛡️' }`. HomePage.tsx:349-356 comment for the trust badges directly below: "'Bug Bounty Active' → 'Responsible Disclosure' (the bounty has no funded pool yet)". Two surfaces on one page disagree about whether a bounty exists; the honesty pass (commit 7639fdf) missed this card.
findings.suggestion: Change sub to 'findings resolved · responsible disclosure' to match the trust badge.

findings.title: 'Fee Share 100% → stakers' hardcoded in two cards contradicts the hero's stakers/liquidity/ops split — and the real split is a live on-chain parameter
findings.evidence: ProtocolStats.tsx:44 `{ l: 'Fee Share', v: '100%', sub: 'of protocol fees → stakers, in ETH' }` and :36 sub '100% to stakers, in ETH'. Hero copy (post honesty pass) at HomePage.tsx:96-97: "Every protocol fee flows on-chain — to stakers, the liquidity engine, and operations." These cannot both be true. The split is configurable on-chain: TreasuryPage.tsx:117-151 reads `stakerShareBps` live (with 10_000 only as a read-failure fallback), and abi-supplement.ts:11491 has proposeFeeSplit/_stakerShareBps. ProtocolStats freezes a governable parameter into marketing copy.
findings.suggestion: Read stakerShareBps the way TreasuryPage does and render the live percentage, or reword to match the hero's three-way framing.

findings.title: Static OG/Twitter meta still carries the pre-honesty-pass '100% of protocol revenue goes to stakers' claim
findings.evidence: index.html:31 `og:description content="... 100% of protocol revenue goes to stakers."` and :45 `og:image:alt content="... where 100% of swap fees flow to stakers"`. The 2026-06-11 honesty pass rewrote the rendered hero (HomePage.tsx:96-97) but crawlers/social cards read the static index.html, so every shared link re-publishes the inflated claim.
findings.suggestion: Align og:description/og:image:alt (and twitter:description, index.html:52) with the honesty-pass wording.

findings.title: 'ETH Distributed' hero pill shows a loading shimmer forever for disconnected visitors — its data source is gated on wallet connection
findings.evidence: HomePage.tsx:181 `{ l: 'ETH Distributed', v: revenueStats.totalDistributed > 0 ? ... : '–' }` renders via :192 `(!s.v || s.v === '–') ? <span ... shimmer/>`. useRevenueStats.ts:37 `query: { enabled: !!address, ... }` — the query never runs without a wallet, so totalDistributed stays 0 and the pill shimmers indefinitely for exactly the first-time visitors the hero targets. The same global value is already fetched wallet-lessly elsewhere on the page: RealYieldProof.tsx:25-29 reads totalDistributed chainId-pinned with `enabled: deployed` (no address gate).
findings.suggestion: Source the pill from a wallet-less read (the RealYieldProof pattern), and reserve the shimmer for genuinely in-flight queries — render an honest '—' for 'no data yet' states (Base APR pre-stake hits the same forever-shimmer path).

findings.title: usePoolData and useRevenueStats reads lack the chainId pin / mainnet gate that useFarmStats got in R043 — wrong-network users see partial/false stats
findings.evidence: useFarmStats.ts:16 comment 'R043 H-062-02: chainId pin on every entry, gate on onMainnet' with `chainId: CHAIN_ID` on each read and `enabled: isDeployed && onMainnet`. usePoolData.ts:10-22 has NO chainId on any of its 8 reads and no network gate; useRevenueStats.ts:21-37 likewise (its writes ARE pinned, :62/:72/:83). A user connected to Base gets failed/foreign-chain reads → APR falls to '–' (perpetual shimmer) while the pinned TVL pill renders, an inconsistent half-broken hero.
findings.suggestion: Add `chainId: CHAIN_ID` to every read in both hooks, matching the R043 pattern.

findings.title: TVL renders a false '0 TOWELI' when its reads are disabled or failing
findings.evidence: useFarmStats.ts:36 `tvl: isDeployed ? (totalStaked > 0n ? \`${...} TOWELI\` : '0 TOWELI') : '–'` — when the query is disabled (wrong network) or the multicall fails, totalStaked defaults to 0n (:26) and the hero confidently prints 'TVL 0 TOWELI'. This is the exact 'wall of zeros reads as a dead protocol' failure the ProtocolStats credibility fix (ProtocolStats.tsx:23-30 comment) was written to ban.
findings.suggestion: Distinguish 'read failed/disabled' (render '–') from a true on-chain zero using the per-call status already available.

findings.title: '$JBM on Base' card links to a generic Uniswap swap page, not the JBM token
findings.evidence: HomePage.tsx:394 `href="https://app.uniswap.org/swap?chain=base"` — no outputCurrency/token param, so users land on Uniswap's default ETH swap on Base and must find JBM themselves. Both sibling cards deep-link correctly (OpenSea collection :382, /lore :406).
findings.suggestion: Append the JBM token address (e.g. ?outputCurrency=0x...&chain=base).

findings.title: Dead fallback in effectiveToweliPrice — both branches resolve from the same PriceContext value
findings.evidence: HomePage.tsx:63 `const effectiveToweliPrice = price.priceInUsd > 0 ? formatCurrency(price.priceInUsd, 6) : stats.toweliPrice;` but useFarmStats.ts:14,37 computes toweliPrice as `effectivePrice > 0 ? formatCurrency(effectivePrice, 6) : '–'` from the SAME useTOWELIPrice() context — the fallback can never yield anything but '–' when the primary is 0. Also usePriceHistory.ts:25 takes `_currentPrice` which is unused; HomePage:59 passes price.priceInUsd into it for nothing.
findings.suggestion: Simplify to one expression; drop the dead hook parameter.

findings.title: '54 original pieces' count includes the same artwork twice in different file formats
findings.evidence: HomePage.tsx:424 renders `{GALLERY_ORDER.length} original pieces` (= 54). artConfig.ts:46-76: naka01=/splash/new/1.avif vs naka08=/splash/new/1.jpg, naka03=7.avif vs naka31=7.jpg, naka04=28.avif vs naka24=28.jpg ('Naka #28' and 'Naka #28b') — 3 works double-counted, so 51 unique pieces. Additive fix only: correct the count, keep all art.
findings.suggestion: Either dedupe the count (display unique works) or keep both files but title/count them as one piece.

findings.title: Six overlapping read-hook batches refetch the same contract values every 30-60s
findings.evidence: On one mount HomePage runs useFarmStats (3 reads), usePoolData (8, also re-mounted inside YieldCalculator — that one dedupes via identical query key), useProtocolStats (6), useRevenueStats (8), useToweliPrice (4) and RealYieldProof (3). totalStaked, rewardRate and totalRewardsFunded are each fetched in 3 separate useReadContracts batches (useFarmStats.ts:19-21, usePoolData.ts:12-16, useProtocolStats.ts:30-32); totalDistributed/totalClaimed/epochCount in 2 (useRevenueStats.ts:24-26, RealYieldProof.tsx:25-27). Distinct contract arrays → distinct tanstack keys → no dedupe across hooks.
findings.suggestion: Fold the public protocol aggregates into one shared hook/context (like PriceContext already does for price) and derive the per-surface shapes from it.

findings.title: aria-live on the rotating Towelie quote announces a joke to screen readers every 7 seconds, forever
findings.evidence: HomePage.tsx:128 `<div className="mt-4 min-h-[22px]" aria-live="polite">` wrapping the AnimatePresence quote that rotates on a 7s interval (:68-73). aria-live is for meaningful updates; a perpetual decorative ticker is an SR annoyance. The interval also keeps firing in hidden tabs.
findings.suggestion: Drop aria-live (keep the quotes visually), pause rotation on document.hidden, and skip rotation under prefers-reduced-motion.

findings.title: role="radio" buttons without the radio-group keyboard pattern; amount label contradicts itself
findings.evidence: YieldCalculator.tsx:151-169: six `<button role="radio" aria-checked>` inside role="radiogroup" but no roving tabindex or arrow-key handling — SR users are told it's a radio group whose arrow keys do nothing. Also :117-118 label reads 'TOWELI amount (USD equivalent)' over a $-prefixed input — it is a USD amount, not a TOWELI amount; the hint (:136) says 'USD-equivalent amount' confirming the label is wrong.
findings.suggestion: Either implement the WAI-ARIA radio pattern or use plain pressed-state buttons; rename the label 'Amount to stake (USD)'.

findings.title: No global prefers-reduced-motion handling for framer-motion
findings.evidence: No MotionConfig anywhere in src (grep for MotionConfig|reducedMotion matches only ParticleBackground.tsx and PulseDot's manual useReducedMotion). All HomePage whileInView springs, the hero entrance, FlashValue scale bumps and the quote cross-fade animate regardless of the OS setting.
findings.suggestion: Wrap the LazyMotion tree (App.tsx:221) in <MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"> — one line, app-wide.

findings.title: Pre-volume state leaves a lopsided grid: 4 cards in a 6-column row
findings.evidence: ProtocolStats.tsx:50 `const items = [...live, ...evergreen].slice(0, 6);` with 0 live items today yields 4 evergreen cards inside :53 `grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6` — on lg the row renders 4 filled + 2 empty columns, left-aligned.
findings.suggestion: Derive the lg column count from items.length (or justify-center the short row).

findings.title: Quote line reserves one line of height but long quotes wrap — rhythmic layout shift on mobile every 7s
findings.evidence: HomePage.tsx:128 `min-h-[22px]` under the CTAs; TOWELIE_QUOTES (copy.ts:111-119) includes 56-char lines ('Wanna get high? Oh wait, wrong farm. Wanna get yield?') that wrap to two lines at 12px italic inside the max-w-xl hero at ~360px width, so the security badge below jumps up/down as quotes rotate.
findings.suggestion: Reserve two lines (min-h-[40px]) or clamp quotes to one line on mobile.

findings.title: Theme toggle has no visible effect on the landing page; gold CTA lacks hover/focus affordance; core-loop microcopy repeats itself
findings.evidence: (1) HomePage hardcodes the dark shell — :77 `style={{ background: '#060c1a' }}`, white text and rgba(0,0,0,.78) pills — while index.css ships [data-theme="light"] variants for the same utilities (index.css:592-680) and TopNav.tsx:257 exposes toggleTheme; flipping to light changes only the nav. Likely intentional for the art-first page but undocumented. (2) :119-123 'Buy TOWELI' Link has transition-all but no hover/focus style that actually changes. (3) :26 step label 'Every swap skims a fee' with sub 'a protocol fee on each swap' says the same thing twice — the sub could carry the fee number instead.
findings.suggestion: Document the theme-invariance decision in a comment; add hover brightness + focus-visible ring to the gold CTA; put the actual fee bps in the core-loop sub line.

findings.title: 4 of 15 home art surfaces ride the deterministic rotation — collision-free today but silently reshuffled by any pool edit
findings.evidence: artOverrides.ts:76-86 covers home:0,1,2,4,5,6,7,10,11,13,14; indexes 3, 8, 9, 12 fall back to pageArt rotation, which (computed: djb2('home')=offset 58 into the 74-piece ART_POOL_ALL) currently resolves to naka19, naka24, naka25, naka28 — no duplicates against the overrides today. But artConfig.ts:243-244's no-duplicate guarantee only holds when ALL of a page's indexes come from rotation; any insertion/removal in ART_POOL_ALL re-derives these 4 picks and can collide with an override (e.g. naka26 already used at home:10). Verified-correct-now, fragile-by-design.
findings.suggestion: Pin the remaining 4 home surfaces via /art-studio (additive — assigns art, removes none).

findings.title: Two swap descriptions on the page disagree about which DEX you trade on; 'Verifiable on Etherscan' predates source-verification landing
findings.evidence: (1) HOW_IT_WORKS step 1 (HomePage.tsx:35): 'Swap ETH for TOWELI on the Tegridy DEX. Nine routes checked' — the nine-route claim itself checks out (aggregator.ts:44 has 7 sources + useSwapQuote.ts:9 tegridy/uniswap = 9, matching TradePage.tsx:411 'Compare all N+2 routes'). But the Protocol Overview Swap card (:291) says 'Trade ETH ↔ TOWELI via Uniswap V2' with stat 'Uniswap V2 / Router' — same page, two different stories about the venue. (2) Hero :97 and the meta description (:53 'verifiable on Etherscan') — per the deploy record the Etherscan source-verify was still pending at relaunch; fee flows are visible as txs, but 'verify the contracts' reads stronger than what an Etherscan visitor finds until verification lands. Unverified hypothesis on current verify status — flagging the dependency, not asserting the claim is false.
findings.suggestion: Align the Swap card with the smart-front-door story ('best of 9 routes' / native DEX + aggregators); confirm source-verify completion before leaning harder on the Etherscan language.

good: Art platform is genuinely well-engineered: central ART registry + deterministic per-page rotation with a documented no-same-page-duplicate property (artConfig.ts:237-272), /art-studio override layer with objectPosition+scale, and ArtImg hardening — default width/height to prevent CLS on 404 (ArtImg.tsx:25-31), decoding=async, onError swap to PLACEHOLDER_NFT, plus an honest regression comment explaining why the <picture>/AVIF attempt was reverted.

Performance-conscious animation setup: LazyMotion strict + `m` components app-wide (App.tsx:214-223), whileInView with viewport={{once:true}} on every scroll reveal, React.memo'd Sparkline with single-pass min/max (R068 comment, Sparkline.tsx:22-30), PulseDot manually honoring prefers-reduced-motion.

Honesty engineering is a real, visible discipline: hero readability scrim documented as additive-only (HomePage.tsx:84-88), trust badges rewritten with dated honesty-pass comments (:349-352), RealYieldProof self-gates to render NOTHING until the first real ETH distribution (RealYieldProof.tsx:36-37), ProtocolStats never renders zero-stats and backfills with checkable evergreen guarantees (ProtocolStats.tsx:23-30), the 'early-stage' APR tooltip (:194-202), and the YieldCalculator's consistent 'estimate' framing.

Price pipeline has defense-in-depth few meme-coin frontends bother with: Chainlink staleness + min/max bounds + answeredInRound check (useToweliPrice.ts:140-167), 30-min TWAP divergence override against single-block manipulation (:189-198), API-vs-on-chain ±1% acceptance gate (:221-239), and versioned localStorage caches that reject future-signed or >24h entries (R075, both useToweliPrice and usePriceHistory).

usePriceHistory is a model fetch hook: exponential-backoff retries, AbortController wired to unmount, per-candle OHLCV validation, versioned cache write-through, and a user-facing error string the hero actually renders.

ReferralWidget R037 contract-as-referrer protection: probes getCode() before allowing Link, disables the button while checking, and surfaces a role=alert warning (ReferralWidget.tsx:99-125, 242-246); also has clipboard API + execCommand fallback, ?ref= URL prefill with self-referral guard, and proper busy states on the claim button.
Wallet-less YieldCalculator gated to disconnected visitors only (HomePage.tsx:170-174) is a smart conversion surface, with aria-live results region and labeled input.

Every CTA target on the page resolves against the route table (verified: /swap, /farm, /dashboard, /security, /lore, /gallery in App.tsx:134-168, plus legacy redirects), and the whole tree sits under RouteErrorBoundary + per-route Suspense skeletons.

chainId pinning on the public-stats hooks (useFarmStats R043, useProtocolStats, RealYieldProof) so the landing page works correctly pre-connect — the pattern exists and is documented, it just hasn't been applied to usePoolData/useRevenueStats reads yet.

SEO/social surface is unusually complete: usePageTitle sets title/description/og/twitter/canonical per route with cleanup; index.html ships raster og:image with secure_url + type + dimensions + alt, JSON-LD, preconnects to image CDNs, dns-prefetch for aggregator APIs, self-hosted preloaded fonts, and an external theme-init script kept out of inline CSP.

formatWei avoids the Number(formatEther()).toFixed() precision anti-pattern by string-slicing (formatting.ts:57-68); formatCurrency handles sub-cent token prices with exponential/8-decimal branches — right for a $0.000x token.

FlashValue uses the correct render-phase previous-value comparison pattern (documented R007) with cleanup-safe timeout, and suppresses the bogus first flash from the 0→loaded transition (FlashValue.tsx:24-30).

The 'Nine routes checked' hero claim is actually true in code: 7 aggregator sources (aggregator.ts:44) + tegridy + uniswap on-chain routes (useSwapQuote.ts:9), matching TradePage's 'Compare all N+2 routes' affordance.

Owner's art constraint is respected by the page's own design system: readability comes from layered text-shadows rather than scrims so art renders at full brightness (comment at HomePage.tsx:326-328).
missingVsBestInClass: USD-denominated TVL: the hero 'TVL' pill shows a raw TOWELI count only (useFarmStats.ts:36) — Uniswap/Aave-grade pages always show USD with the token figure secondary; the price needed for the conversion is already in PriceContext.

24h price change % next to the price pill — priceChange exists in the context (useToweliPrice returns it) and a 24h OHLCV series is already fetched for the sparkline, but no percent badge is rendered; the sparkline also has no tooltip or 24h label (Dexscreener-grade affordance).

Token contract address strip with copy button + 'Add TOWELI to wallet' (wallet_watchAsset) — the single most common buy-page affordance; the address exists in constants but is never surfaced on the landing page (only on /contracts).
Market stats strip (market cap / holders / liquidity) with a GeckoTerminal/Dexscreener link-out — GECKOTERMINAL_URL is already built in constants.ts:134 but unused on Home.

Live activity feed or 'recent swaps/stakes' ticker (even simple Etherscan link-outs pre-indexer) — best-in-class landing pages prove liveness with motion in the data, which matters double for a just-relaunched protocol whose stats are honestly small.
FAQ teaser/accordion and a docs/litepaper CTA above the footer — the FAQ page and FAQ_INTRO copy exist (copy.ts:100-104) but Home never funnels to them.
Community/social proof above the footer: no Twitter/Telegram/Discord links anywhere in the hero or trust-badge row (Telegram only lives in the Footer).

Referral deep-link continuity: ?ref= should persist across navigation and be honored by the Buy TOWELI CTA (carry the param to /swap), instead of only being read if the visitor connects while still on the home route.
Share/export: no 'share this protocol' or OG-card preview affordance beyond the referral tweet button (which only renders for connected users).

Network-mismatch banner on the landing stats: competitors show 'viewing Ethereum data' or auto-mainnet reads regardless of wallet chain; here a wrong-chain wallet silently degrades parts of the hero (see chainId-pin finding).

findings.page: nakamigos modal stack (Modal.jsx + TheaterMode.jsx + ShareCard.jsx + WalletModal.jsx)
findings.title: Escape key closes the WRONG modal in every stacked-overlay combination
findings.evidence: Modal.jsx:162-168 registers a document keydown handler that on Escape calls `e.stopImmediatePropagation()` then `onClose()`. TheaterMode (App.jsx:769 `onTheater={() => setTheaterNft(selected)}`), ShareCard (App.jsx:770) and WalletModal (Modal.jsx:425 `onConnect?.()` -> App.jsx:509-511) all mount as SIBLINGS while `selected` stays set, so the NFT Modal remains mounted underneath (App.jsx:754-778 vs 799-847). Document listeners fire in registration order: Modal's older handler runs first, stops immediate propagation (TheaterMode.jsx:150-151, ShareCard.jsx:151, WalletModal.jsx:32 handlers never run) and closes the BOTTOM modal — the theater/share/wallet overlay on top stays open with its parent gone. Worse, Modal's effect deps are `[nft, onClose]` (Modal.jsx:195) and onClose is an inline arrow recreated every AppInner render (App.jsx:759-763), so the listener re-registers on any state change (toast, poll), flipping the order — then a single Escape closes BOTH layers (TheaterMode doesn't stop propagation). Verified by code reading; behavior depends only on registration order, both orders are wrong.
findings.suggestion: Introduce a tiny modal-stack registry (push on mount, pop on unmount; only the top entry handles Escape), or have each overlay handler check it is topmost before acting and always stopImmediatePropagation. Stabilize Modal's onClose with useCallback in App.jsx.

findings.title: TheaterMode/ShareCard bypass the ref-counted scrollLock and unlock body scroll behind the still-open NFT modal
findings.evidence: lib/scrollLock.js implements a ref-counted lock used by Modal.jsx:184/192 and WalletModal.jsx:47/53, but TheaterMode.jsx:132-133 and ShareCard.jsx:165-168 write `document.body.style.overflow = "hidden"` / `""` directly (also BulkListingWizard.jsx:553-554 and BundleListing.jsx:63-68). Repro path: open NFT Modal (lockScroll, count=1) -> open Theater from it -> close Theater (cleanup sets overflow="") -> body scrolls behind the still-open Modal, and the lock count is desynced.
findings.suggestion: Replace all four direct `body.style.overflow` writes with lockScroll()/unlockScroll() from lib/scrollLock.js.

findings.title: Theater mode has zero mobile adaptation — 300px trait sidebar and paddingRight crush the image on phones
findings.evidence: TheaterMode.jsx:189 `paddingRight: showTraits ? 300 : 0` and :291-307 sidebar `width: 300` are fixed inline styles with no media queries anywhere in the component; on a 375px iPhone, opening TRAITS leaves ~75px for the artwork, and the vertical writing-mode toggle button (:349-370) sits at the right edge. The project mandate (project_responsive.md) requires flawless iPhone 14+/iPad behavior. HUD bar `padding: "14px 28px"` (:223) is also desktop-sized.
findings.suggestion: Additively: at <=640px make the trait panel a bottom sheet (full-width, max-height 50vh) and drop the image paddingRight; keep the desktop layout untouched.

findings.title: Mobile bottom nav (z 9997-9999) floats above the NFT/Wallet modal overlay (z 1000) and stays tappable
findings.evidence: App.css:662 `.modal-bg { z-index: 1000 }` while MobileNav.jsx:60/109/123 uses fixed position with zIndex 9997-9999 and is rendered unconditionally (App.jsx:866). On phones the bottom nav bar paints over the open modal's backdrop/bottom edge (modal-content is 90-95vh per App.css:3604-3618), and tapping a nav tab switches tabs underneath while the modal stays open. The z-map comment at App.css:14-32 itself documents modal=1000 < mobile nav=9997.
findings.suggestion: Hide MobileNav while any overlay is open (it already receives app state), or raise .modal-bg above 9999 to match Theater/Share which already use 9999.

findings.page: nakamigos keyboard shortcuts (KeyboardHelp.jsx + About.jsx vs App.jsx)
findings.title: Both shortcut listings shown to users are wrong vs the actual handler
findings.evidence: Actual TAB_KEYS map is only "1"-"6" (App.jsx:114-121) and the switch handles g/f/c/s,//m/?/escape (App.jsx:452-503). KeyboardHelp.jsx:10 advertises `["1–9, 0", "Switch tabs"]` (7,8,9,0 do nothing), and About.jsx:347-355 lists `["1-7","Switch tabs"]`, `["F","Go to Floor"]` and `["T","Go to Traits"]` — F actually toggles favorite on the focused card and there is no T shortcut at all. About also omits j/k, c, m and ?.
findings.suggestion: Derive both lists from one shared SHORTCUTS constant (export from a lib module) so they cannot drift; fix the tab range to 1-6.

findings.page: frontend global (nakamigos/App.css leaking into main app)
findings.title: Unscoped selectors in nakamigos App.css apply to the entire Tegriddy app (eagerly bundled via main.tsx)
findings.evidence: main.tsx:15 `import './nakamigos/App.css'` loads it on every page. Unscoped rules: App.css:3663-3667 `@media (max-width:768px) { button, a, select, input { min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; } }` forces 44px boxes on every main-app control on mobile; :1862 `details summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none }` hides all disclosure markers app-wide; :3535-3538 `*:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--naka-blue) }` — `--naka-blue` is only defined on `.nakamigos-app`, so outside it the var is invalid-at-computed-value and the focus outline degrades; :3545-3552 reduced-motion kill + `.splash-screen{display:none}` and :4419 `main, [role="main"] { padding-bottom: 68px }` (inside max-390px) also apply app-wide; :3678-3687 forced-colors button rule unscoped.
findings.suggestion: Prefix all of these with `.nakamigos-app` (the file's own button rules at :239 already document this exact leak having happened before).

findings.title: Unstable onClose dependency makes the modal re-register listeners and yank keyboard focus back to the close button on every app re-render
findings.evidence: Modal.jsx:159-195 effect has deps `[nft, onClose]`; App.jsx:759 passes an inline `onClose={() => {...}}` recreated each render. Every AppInner re-render (toast appearing, stats/listings poll, price alerts at App.jsx:566-569) tears down and re-runs the effect, whose body refocuses the close button (`closeBtn?.focus()` Modal.jsx:188-189) and re-captures `previouslyFocused`. A keyboard user who tabbed to 'Make Offer' gets focus snapped back to ✕ whenever a toast fires.
findings.suggestion: Wrap the App.jsx onClose in useCallback and/or move focus-trap setup into a mount-only effect separate from the Escape handler.

findings.title: Global shortcuts still fire under theater mode; pressing F can double-toggle the favorite (net no-op)
findings.evidence: TheaterMode.jsx:149-157 handles t/f/Escape on document without stopping propagation and without suppressing the app-level window handler (App.jsx:405-507). With a card keyboard-focused via j/k, pressing F in theater runs `onToggleFavorite?.(nft.id)` (TheaterMode.jsx:153) AND App.jsx:454-463 toggles the focused card's favorite — same token toggled twice = no visible change. Digits 1-6/g also switch tabs underneath the open theater.
findings.suggestion: In TheaterMode's keydown handler call e.stopPropagation() (it is on document, app handler is on window, so it runs first when theater registered later — also gate the app handler on overlay-open state).

findings.title: Theater overlay has no dialog semantics, no focus management, no focus trap
findings.evidence: TheaterMode.jsx:372-441: the root div has no role="dialog"/aria-modal/aria-label (Modal, ShareCard, KeyboardHelp, WalletModal all have them); focus is never moved into the overlay on open and Tab walks the page behind it; fav/close buttons rely on title only (no aria-pressed on the favorite toggle, though Modal.jsx:259 does set it).
findings.suggestion: Add role=dialog aria-modal aria-label, focus the close button on mount, add the same Tab trap used in KeyboardHelp.jsx:108-126.

findings.title: After a successful buy the modal still shows the stale 'Buy for X ETH' button
findings.evidence: Modal.jsx:434-438 onSuccess records the tx and toasts but never clears nft.orderHash/price, closes the modal, or refetches; the primary CTA continues to offer the just-filled order (a second click would revert with 'OrderAlreadyFilled', mapped at errorMessages.js:19).
findings.suggestion: On success, flip the CTA to a disabled 'Purchased ✓ — view on Etherscan (hash)' state and/or trigger a listings refetch.

findings.title: Two parallel toast systems live in one app
findings.evidence: Main app uses sonner (grep: components/GaugeVoting.tsx, community/*, swap/* import sonner) while nakamigos ships its own Toast.jsx + ToastContext.jsx mounted at App.jsx:863. Visual language, positioning (bottom-right fixed at App.css:848-853) and behavior (no pause-on-hover, errors auto-dismiss in the same 3500ms as successes, Toast.jsx:35) differ from the rest of the site.
findings.suggestion: Keep the nakamigos skin but add pause-on-hover and a longer/persistent duration for type="error"; longer-term, theme sonner with the nakamigos classes to converge.

findings.title: Tweet intent contains no link back to the app and the generated image is never shared — only downloadable
findings.evidence: ShareCard.jsx:183-188 builds `twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=...` with name+rank only (no url param), while Modal.jsx:343 already has a canonical deep link (`/nakamigos/${slug}/gallery?token=${id}`) with per-NFT OG cards per its own comment. There is no navigator.share (Web Share API Level 2 can attach the PNG on mobile) and no copy-image-to-clipboard (ClipboardItem).
findings.suggestion: Append the deep-link URL to the tweet text, and add Web Share / copy-image buttons when supported.

findings.title: Collection name header drawn with no maxWidth — long names overflow the 1200x630 canvas
findings.evidence: ShareCard.jsx:41-43 `ctx.fillText(collection.name.toUpperCase(), rx, 80)` omits the maxWidth argument that the NFT-name line uses (`ctx.fillText(name, rx, 135, rw)` at :49). In Press Start 2P at 20px, 'GENERATIVE NATURE SYNTHETIC SPECIES'-length names paint past x=1160.
findings.suggestion: Pass `rw` as maxWidth for the header fillText too.

findings.title: Pseudo-domain branding and supply copy drift
findings.evidence: ShareCard.jsx:105 prints `${collection.slug}.gallery` (e.g. 'nakamigos.gallery') as the card footer — a domain the project does not appear to own — instead of the real share URL. About.jsx:154 says final population '~9,697' while constants.js:33 says supply 9696 ('On-chain totalSupply').
findings.suggestion: Print the real host (window.location.host) on the card; align the GNSS number with constants.

findings.title: 390px rule flattens section bottom padding contrary to its own comment
findings.evidence: App.css:4386-4396: comment says '/* Sections: tighter horizontal padding */' but the rule `.activity-section, .analytics-section, .my-collection-section, .listings-section, .trait-explorer, .favorites-section, .footer-full { padding: 14px 10px; }` also collapses the 60px bottom padding these sections get at 768px (e.g. :2455-2457) down to 14px, so content butts against the footer/bottom nav on small iPhones (partially masked by `main { padding-bottom: 68px }` at :4419).
findings.suggestion: Use padding-left/right only in that block.

findings.title: Focus traps include disabled buttons, so the Tab cycle can no-op at the edges
findings.evidence: All four traps use `querySelectorAll('button, [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])')` (Modal.jsx:172, ShareCard.jsx:153, WalletModal.jsx:35, KeyboardHelp.jsx:111) without filtering `:disabled`. While buying, Modal's Buy button is disabled (Modal.jsx:422) — if it is first/last, `first.focus()` silently fails and Tab escapes the modal.
findings.suggestion: Add `:not([disabled])` to the button selector in the shared pattern (ideally extract one trapFocus util — the same 10 lines are copy-pasted in 4 files).

findings.title: CR-only and CRLF values are not quoted; rows with heterogeneous keys silently lose columns
findings.evidence: csv.js:15 quotes only on `val.includes(",") || val.includes('"') || val.includes("\n")` — a value containing a bare `\r` breaks the row in Excel; csv.js:6 takes headers from `Object.keys(rows[0])` only, so keys present on later rows are dropped.
findings.suggestion: Add `\r` to the quote condition and union keys across rows (or document the contract).

findings.title: The 'one formatter' exists but Modal, About, ShareCard and PriceHistoryChart bypass it; dust values render as '0.0000'
findings.evidence: formatPrice is used by 11 components (Card, VirtualGalleryGrid, Watchlist, etc.) but Modal.jsx:364/367/445, About.jsx:70, FairValueBadge (Modal.jsx:40) and PriceHistoryChart (:106-108) use raw `.toFixed(4)` — a 1234.5 ETH value would show '1234.5000' instead of '1,234.50'. Also formatPrice.js:21: any non-zero value < 0.00005 renders '0.0000', indistinguishable from zero (Blur/OpenSea show '<0.0001').
findings.suggestion: Route the modal/about price strings through formatPrice and add a `< 0.0001` floor display.

findings.title: Eth icon is unit-bearing but invisible to screen readers
findings.evidence: Icons.jsx:1-10: the SVG has no role/aria-label/title and no aria-hidden; it is used as the ETH unit next to bare numbers (e.g. Modal.jsx:360 `<Eth size={20} /> 0.1234`), so SR users hear a unitless number.
findings.suggestion: Add `role="img" aria-label="ETH"` (or aria-hidden plus a visually-hidden 'ETH' text next to prices).

findings.title: Price history chart pops in with no skeleton, no dates, no tooltips, no SVG a11y
findings.evidence: Modal.jsx:68 `if (!sales) return null` — content appears after fetch causing layout shift below the price box; points (:99-103) carry no date/tx info and no hover affordance; the svg (:92) has no aria-label/title. Each modal open refetches (`useEffect` on tokenId/contract at :55-66; caching unverified in api.js).
findings.suggestion: Render a fixed-height skeleton while null, add <title> per point with date+price, aria-label on the svg.

findings.title: No pause-on-hover and errors share the 3.5s auto-dismiss of successes
findings.evidence: Toast.jsx:35 `const duration = t.duration || 3500` applies uniformly; there are no mouseenter handlers to pause timers, and undo toasts (UNDO button, :71-81) give users only 3.5s to react. Sonner (the main app's system) pauses on hover by default.
findings.suggestion: Pause the timer on container hover/focus; default error/undo types to 6-8s.

findings.title: JS-driven hover styles stick on touch devices; 'terms of use' has no link; unknown connectors get no description
findings.evidence: WalletModal.jsx:131-138 set styles in onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave — on iOS a tap fires mouseenter and the highlight persists; :285 'By connecting, you agree to the terms of use.' links nowhere; :172-176 description lines only exist for 6 hardcoded connector ids, others render an empty row.
findings.suggestion: Move hover to a CSS class (the file's own buttons elsewhere do), link the terms, add a generic 'Browser wallet' fallback description.

findings.title: Programmatic alert sounds may be silent until the next user gesture
findings.evidence: useSound.js:143-151 creates/resumes the AudioContext inside play(), but useSmartAlerts/usePriceAlerts (App.jsx:566-569) can call play() with no preceding gesture; `ctxRef.current.resume()` is fire-and-forget so the first alert chirp can be dropped by autoplay policy. Not a crash — sounds resume after any click.
findings.suggestion: Pre-warm the context on first pointer/keydown (one-shot listener), or queue the alert sound until the context state is 'running'.

findings.title: Scroll lock causes scrollbar layout shift on Windows and is unreliable on older iOS Safari
findings.evidence: scrollLock.js:8-11 only sets `overflow: hidden` — desktop Windows loses the ~15px scrollbar (content jumps behind every modal open), and body overflow:hidden does not fully lock scroll on iOS Safari < 16 (the documented position:fixed technique is absent).
findings.suggestion: Add `padding-right: <scrollbarWidth>` compensation or `scrollbar-gutter: stable`, and the position:fixed/top:-scrollY fallback for iOS.

findings.page: nakamigos rank badges (Modal vs ShareCard vs TheaterMode)
findings.title: Three different rank-tier semantics across surfaces
findings.evidence: Modal.jsx:229 shows a rank badge only for top 25%; ShareCard.jsx:57-61 colors gold at top 0.5% and blue at top 2.5%; TheaterMode.jsx:162 shows RANK for any `rank <= supply`. Card.css has a separate `.card-rank-top` top-25% style. Same NFT reads as 'special' on one surface and unremarkable on another.
findings.suggestion: Centralize tier thresholds in constants (e.g. rankTier(rank, supply) -> gold/blue/plain) and reuse everywhere.

findings.title: Reduced-motion blanket freezes spinners; sovereign card shimmer is likely occluded; dead empty media blocks
findings.evidence: App.css:3545-3551 `* { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important }` freezes `.spinner` (:653-658) into a static arc for reduced-motion users (a frozen 'loading' indicator reads as hung). App.css:3424-3435 sovereign `.nft-card::before` shimmer uses `inset:-2px; z-index:-1` while `.nft-card` has `overflow:hidden` (:537) and an opaque image/footer covering it — shimmer is mostly/fully invisible (unverified hypothesis, needs a visual check). Empty blocks at :3512-3513, :3600-3601, :3650-3651 are dead code; `.activity-filter-btn.active` is defined twice with competing palettes (:2033 vs :2488).
findings.suggestion: Swap spinners to an opacity pulse under reduced motion; verify the sovereign shimmer visually and move it above the background if intended; delete empty blocks.

findings.title: Help panel can overflow short viewports; toasts overlap the mobile bottom nav
findings.evidence: KeyboardHelp.jsx:33-41 panel has fixed padding and no max-height/overflow — on landscape phones (~370px height) the ~500px content clips with no scroll. App.css:848-853 `.toast-container { bottom: 24px }` sits on top of the 56px mobile bottom nav (z 10500 > 9999), covering nav buttons while visible.
findings.suggestion: Add `max-height: 85vh; overflow-y: auto` to the panel; bump toast bottom offset to ~72px under 767px.

findings.title: No light theme and no print styles in the nakamigos surface
findings.evidence: App.css defines three dark themes only (default/midnight/sovereign, :101-135) with no prefers-color-scheme: light handling; there is no `@media print` block anywhere in App.css (the main app's index.css:817 has one). Printing the About/lore page or a share card yields dark-on-dark output.
findings.suggestion: Additively add a minimal print block (white bg, black text, hide nav/marquee) — no need for a full light theme given the art direction.

good: lib/scrollLock.js is a correctly designed ref-counted lock (the bug is adoption, not design) — Modal/WalletModal/KeyboardHelp use it properly

App.jsx global shortcut handler has proper guards: input/textarea/select target check (App.jsx:406), modifier-key bailout (:415), and Ctrl+Shift+P pro-mode toggle — typing in search does NOT trigger shortcuts
lib/csv.js: formula-injection protection (=+-@|% prefix), correct quote escaping, UTF-8 BOM for Excel, deferred URL.revokeObjectURL — well engineered for its size
lib/errorMessages.js: comprehensive Seaport/ethers/gas/nonce error map with hex/url scrubbing, 120-char cap fallback, and isUserRejection helper
lib/formatPrice.js exists as a single canonical formatter and IS used by 11 list/portfolio components

Toast system: 500ms duplicate suppression in ToastContext, undo actions, persistent flag, animated dismissal with full timer cleanup (including unmount and removed-toast sweeps), aria-live=polite container with max-height scroll

Modal.jsx: focus trap + focus restore to previously-focused element, Escape layering ref for the inner MakeOfferModal, deep-link copy fixed to a real route (documented in-code), honest approximate trait-rarity denominators with 'based on X/Y loaded' caption and ~ marker, order pre-validation (validateOrderQuick) with red/yellow warning UI — a tx-simulation-style affordance many marketplaces lack

useSound: single AudioContext owned by App (one hook consumer), lazily created on gesture, suspended-resume handling, close on unmount with rationale comment, mute persisted to localStorage, tasteful 8-bit synth palette matching the pixel aesthetic, reverb only on 'buy'
AnimatedCard: respects prefers-reduced-motion via useReducedMotion, memoized, stagger delay capped at 0.6s, disables Card's CSS reveal to avoid double fade
TheaterMode particles: visibilitychange pause/resume, rAF cancellation, canvas width=0 disposal on unmount, particle state preserved across resizes

App.css: documented z-index hierarchy header, three-theme system with deep coverage (focus-visible, skip-nav, scrollbars, ::selection, empty/loading/error states all themed), forced-colors (high-contrast) support, hover-none/pointer-coarse blocks disabling hover jank on touch, breakpoints at 360/390/480/640/768/1024 incl. an iPhone-SE-specific block, aspect-ratio layout-shift prevention, consolidated empty/loading/error/skeleton primitives

WalletModal: auto-close only when connection happened after open (wasConnectedOnMount ref), friendly connect-error mapping, missing WalletConnect projectID notice, connectError normalized to string in WalletContext (so .includes is safe)
All overlays lazy-loaded with a grouped ErrorBoundary whose onReset clears every overlay state (App.jsx:799); tab boundary keyed by tab to prevent latched crashes (documented in-code)
Google Fonts injection deferred to nakamigos mount with clear rationale comments (avoids 503s on main-app pages); only the actually-used font is loaded
KeyboardHelp: proper dialog semantics, initial focus on close button, Tab trap, ESC/? to close with on-screen hint
missingVsBestInClass: TheaterMode: no zoom/pan (pinch or scroll-zoom), no prev/next navigation between NFTs from within theater (j/k dead there), no image download button, no Fullscreen API usage — OpenSea/Blur lightboxes have all four

ShareCard: no Web Share API with file attach (mobile-native share sheet), no copy-image-to-clipboard, no link in the tweet intent, no Farcaster/Lens share targets, single fixed 1200x630 layout (no story/square format toggle)

Price surfaces: no USD equivalents in the NFT modal price box or share card (listing cards elsewhere show listing-card-usd, so the FX data exists); PriceHistoryChart has no time axis, no marketplace source per sale, no hover tooltips
Success toasts after buy don't deep-link the tx hash to Etherscan even though recordTransaction already has it
Sound: binary mute only — no volume control; no distinct sound when an offer is received
Keyboard: no arrow-key grid navigation (j/k is linear only), no 'b' buy shortcut on focused card, no Escape-to-clear search affordance from within the input
CSV export: no column selection or current-filter-aware export, no JSON option
No print stylesheet and no light theme anywhere in the nakamigos surface
Help modal: shortcut list is static text — best-in-class (Linear/Notion-style) highlights the key just pressed and stays accurate by deriving from the real keymap
pagesCovered: nakamigos/App.css (full, 4483 lines: design tokens, themes, animations, responsive blocks, reduced-motion, a11y)

Supporting: App.jsx (keyboard wiring, overlay mounting, font injection), contexts/ToastContext.jsx, contexts/WalletContext.jsx, constants.js (collections/TAB_KEYS), components/MobileNav.jsx (z-index), components/Card.jsx (skipReveal/data-token-id), lib/interactions.js (springs), main.tsx (eager App.css import), main-app index.css (collision check)

findings.title: Light theme is broken app-wide: navy headings on dark backgrounds are illegible
findings.evidence: Toggled the sun icon. On Home, 'Yield with' and 'Protocol Overview'/'By the Numbers' render dark-navy (~rgb(42,42,110)) on the dark brown mural — zoomed screenshots show the text nearly invisible. On /farm the h1 'Farm', 'Liquidity Pools', 'LP Farming' are the same navy-on-near-black; the 4 art stat cards (TVL/PRICE/APR/SEASON) and the Season 3 banner get flat washed-out GRAY overlays that bury the art. Only the header turns orange — page backgrounds stay dark. Reproduced identically on localhost:5173 (HEAD), so NOT fixed.
findings.suggestion: Either make light mode actually light (light page background + dark text) or scope heading colors so they stay light-on-dark wherever the mural/dark backgrounds persist. Audit every text-on-art combination in light mode.

findings.title: Referral links point to dead domain tegridy.farm
findings.evidence: Referral box displays tegridy.farm/?ref=0x1489...456E; the Tweet intent href contains url=https%3A%2F%2Ftegridy.farm%2F%3Fref%3D0x14898258...456E. fetch('https://tegridy.farm/',{mode:'no-cors'}) fails with 'Failed to fetch' (network/DNS-level — site unreachable). Hardcoded at HEAD in frontend/src/components/ReferralWidget.tsx:71 (`https://tegridy.farm/?ref=${...}`), so every shared referral link and tweet 404s/dead-ends.
findings.suggestion: Point referral links at the canonical live origin (tegridyfarms.vercel.app or window.location.origin) until tegridy.farm is actually registered + aliased; fix ReferralWidget.tsx:71 and :94.

findings.title: 'ETH Distributed' hero stat never loads — permanent skeleton shimmer
findings.evidence: The 4th hero chip shows label 'ETH Distributed' with an empty dark shimmer pill. Watched 30+ seconds across 4 separate page loads (prod) and on localhost HEAD — it never resolves to a value. DOM check: the chip's parent textContent is just 'ETH Distributed', no value node. TVL/Price/APR chips next to it all resolve.
findings.suggestion: Wire the value (RevenueDistributor lifetime ETH) or show an honest '0 ETH — fees start at pool seed' state. A permanently-loading stat directly under the 'Every protocol fee flows on-chain — verifiable' claim is a trust hole; it is the one number that proves the pitch.

findings.title: 'Dashboard' shown as active nav item while on Home (/)
findings.evidence: On https://tegridyfarms.vercel.app/ after a session that visited /dashboard, the nav 'Dashboard' link renders green rgb(34,197,94) with underline while location.pathname is '/' (zoom screenshot + getComputedStyle both confirm). Could NOT reproduce on localhost:5173 HEAD with the same flow (link stays cream rgb(245,228,184)) — appears already fixed at HEAD; verify after next deploy.
findings.suggestion: Redeploy and re-verify; stale prod build seems to carry an active-match bug HEAD no longer has.

findings.title: Towelie mascot covers the fixed 'Protocol Active + price' status pill
findings.evidence: DOM: div.fixed.bottom-4.right-4.z-40 contains 'Protocol Active$0.00004237'; elementFromPoint over it returns the Towelie IMG — the mascot (higher z) sits directly on top, hiding the pill ('$0...' peeks out from behind the avatar in zoomed screenshots). On localhost before the mascot mounts, the pill is fully visible — confirming the collision.
findings.suggestion: Offset the pill left of the mascot (e.g. right-24) or raise its z-index and shift the mascot; both elements are bottom-right fixed.

findings.title: Supply Distribution chart renders empty — legend only, no pie/donut
findings.evidence: On /tokenomics (prod AND localhost HEAD) the 'Supply Distribution' card is a large empty black area with only the legend (Circulating 45%, LP Seed 30%, Treasury 10%, Community 10%, Team 5%) rendered at the bottom. Zoomed screenshot shows zero chart pixels.
findings.suggestion: Fix the chart render (canvas/SVG likely sized 0 or data not passed); the legend proves the data is present.

findings.title: Splash has a long black hold, no skip affordance hint, and tiny art labels
findings.evidence: First visit (cleared storage): ~1-2.5s of pure black before any art, then 2 art pieces (~2s each, labels 'MUMU THE BULL' / 'NAKA #19' in very small low-contrast caps), a ~3-4s particle dissolve, then an indefinite 'CLICK TO ENTER' gate — ~9-10s minimum before any content plus a required click. Clicking mid-slideshow does skip ahead (verified), but nothing tells the user that. Repeat visits correctly skip the splash (sessionStorage tf_loaded) — good.
findings.suggestion: Additive: show a subtle 'click to skip' hint + a progress dot per art piece, start the first art frame sooner (preload), and consider making the gate auto-advance with 'click to enter early' rather than blocking.

findings.title: Inconsistent transition quality: Swap shows a blank-dark flash with a stray orange line; Dashboard has proper skeletons
findings.evidence: Farm->Swap: first frame after click is an almost-empty dark screen with a faint floating orange horizontal divider and ghost footer (~1-2s) before the swap card pops in. Dashboard shows real shimmer skeleton cards (good). Home repeat-load shows a 'Loading...' spinner page where the footer is already visible, then the hero mural image pops in 3-5s AFTER the text content with no fade/placeholder — a jarring late background swap.
findings.suggestion: Add the Dashboard-style skeleton to the Swap route chunk, fade the hero mural in (blur-up/LQIP), and hide the footer during the route-loading state.

findings.title: Primary nav covers a fraction of the app; naming inconsistencies
findings.evidence: Header: Dashboard, Farm, Trade, More(Gallery, Tegridy Score, Tokenomics, Treasury), Tradermigos. Footer exposes 13+ destinations (Points, Lore, History, Changelog, FAQ, Contracts, Security, Risks...) not reachable from the header. Same route /leaderboard is called 'Tegridy Score' in More but 'Points' in footer; nav says 'Trade' while the route/h1 say 'Swap'; /nft-finance (a whole product area with Lending/AMM/Launchpad) is not in the header at all.
findings.suggestion: Additive: expand More into grouped sections (Engage/Stats/Docs+Legal) including NFT Finance and Community, and unify 'Points'/'Tegridy Score' naming.

findings.title: document.title not set on NFT Finance page + raw '--%' placeholder stat
findings.evidence: After /restake -> /nft-finance, document.title stays the generic 'Tegridy Farms | TOWELI Yield Farm' (every other audited page sets 'X | Tegridy Farms'). Stats row shows PROTOCOL FEE '--%' as raw double-dash beside TOTAL OFFERS 0 / TVL 0.0000.
findings.suggestion: Set 'NFT Finance | Tegridy Farms' and render the known protocol fee constant (or 'TBD at deploy') instead of '--%'.

findings.title: Non-art pages waste the ultrawide canvas
findings.evidence: Home/Farm fill the width with the mural (excellent). But /swap is a single ~600px card centered in a void of flat black; /community and /tokenomics similarly float a narrow column with enormous empty side margins — viewport is 3046 CSS px wide, content uses ~1100px.
findings.suggestion: Additive: on xl+ widths, give Swap a side panel (chart/recent trades/route detail) and let stat pages use 2-column layouts; or extend the mural/starfield art to these routes so the void feels intentional.

findings.title: Both 'Copy' and 'Copy Link' buttons flip to 'Copied!' when only one is clicked
findings.evidence: Clicked the main Copy button (ref_295); screenshot shows BOTH the top 'Copy' button and the SHARE-row 'Copy Link' button simultaneously showing 'Copied!' — shared state.
findings.suggestion: Track copied state per button.

findings.title: Rotating Towelie quote under CTAs is near-illegible and sometimes absent
findings.evidence: Quote line ('Remember: always bring a towel. And your LP tokens.' — Towelie) renders ~11px italic dark-gray over the busy mural; required zoom to read. On one load the slot was empty, shifting the trust badge up.
findings.suggestion: Bump contrast/size slightly or add a subtle backdrop blur pill behind it; reserve the line height to avoid layout shift.

findings.title: eth.llamarpc.com returns 503 on page load
findings.evidence: read_network_requests: POST https://eth.llamarpc.com/ -> 503, alongside publicnode 200 and rpc.ankr.com 200. Failover absorbs it (no console error), but it adds dead latency on every load that races it.
findings.suggestion: Demote or health-check llamarpc in the transport list.

findings.title: No aria-current on active nav items
findings.evidence: All header links return ariaCurrent:null even when visually active (green underline). Active state is color-only.
findings.suggestion: Add aria-current='page' to the active link; also pair the green with the underline everywhere (it is there) — keep both.

findings.title: Aggregator proxy function missing from prod deploy — all 7 quote sources silently dead
findings.evidence: Fired the exact quote calls the connected UI makes (1 ETH -> TOWELI): GET /api/swapapi/..., /api/lifi/v1/quote, /api/kyber/.../routes, /api/openocean/v4/eth/quote, /api/paraswap/prices ALL return the SPA's index.html (HTTP 200, 7667-byte HTML, starts '<!doctype'); POST /api/odos/sor/quote/v2 and /api/cow/mainnet/api/v1/quote return 405. The function path itself /api/aggregator/paraswap/prices also returns index.html, while sibling functions /api/etherscan (400 'Module not allowed') and /api/v1 (400 'Missing route parameter') ARE live. HEAD has api/aggregator/[provider]/[...path].js + vercel.json rewrites (frontend/vercel.json:70-77) and api/SERVERLESS_BUDGET.md lists the catchall as deployed function #9 — so prod is a stale deploy missing it. Frontend catches every failure ('catch { return null; }' in src/lib/aggregator.ts) so connected users silently lose CoW/Odos/Kyber/LiFi/OpenOcean/ParaSwap/SwapAPI routing with zero error surfaced.
findings.suggestion: Redeploy prod from HEAD (repo root, per your deploy procedure) and verify /api/aggregator/paraswap/prices returns JSON. Add a one-line health/telemetry signal when 0 aggregators respond so this class of silent regression is visible (the 'smart front-door' revenue architecture depends on these quotes).

findings.title: Token selector modal never becomes visible — token selection is unusable
findings.evidence: On localhost:5173 with a connected session, clicking the ETH/TOWELI token chips does nothing visible (tested physical click, ref click, and programmatic btn.click()). The dialog DOES mount ([role=dialog] present, search input 'Search name, symbol, or paste address' in DOM) but computed styles stay opacity:0 on the outer container and opacity:0 + scale(0.95) on the card — the framer-motion entrance animation never runs (prefers-reduced-motion: false). Compounding bug in code: TokenSelectModal.tsx:261-263 inner m.div has initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }} but animate={{ scale: 1 }} — opacity is omitted from the animate target, so even a running animation leaves the card invisible. Forcing inline opacity showed only the backdrop; framer re-stomped the card styles.
findings.suggestion: Add opacity: 1 to the inner m.div animate target, and debug why the AnimatePresence subtree's animations never start (LazyMotion feature loading vs late-mounted m components is the likely culprit). Add an e2e assertion that the dialog is VISIBLE (opacity/visibility), not just present in the DOM.

findings.title: Route Savings renders raw scientific notation: '+4.6032354236937436e+21% vs worst venue'
findings.evidence: Typed 1 ETH: the Route panel showed 'Route Savings +4.6032354236937436e+21% vs worst venue'. Root cause is a unit mismatch in TradePage.tsx:98-108 (routeSavingsPct): allAggQuotes[].amountOut is in WEI (smallest unit, per AggregatorQuote docs in src/lib/aggregator.ts:48) while tegridyOutputFormatted/uniOutputFormatted are human-formatted token amounts; parseFloat over both mixes 3.5e25 wei with 770318.6 tokens, producing an astronomic percentage that toFixed(2) renders in exponential form.
findings.suggestion: Normalize aggregator amountOut with formatUnits(amountOut, toToken.decimals) before comparing/displaying, and clamp/sanity-cap the displayed savings percent.

findings.title: Route-details venue rows display raw wei: 'kyberswap 3.545958182079852e+25'

The three aggregator rows are the same ~35.4M TOWELI price shown in raw wei because TradePage.tsx:431 calls formatTokenAmount(q.amountOut) on the wei string without dividing by decimals. Users cannot compare venues, and it looks like aggregators offer 10^18 better prices.
findings.suggestion: Same fix as the savings bug: convert aggregator amountOut to token units before formatTokenAmount.

findings.title: Everything is gated behind wallet connect — no quotes, tokens, prices, or pool data logged out

findings.title: Approve tx (and 5 other actions) fires a fake 'stake' success receipt + confetti
findings.evidence: FarmPage.tsx:107-116 handleStake calls actions.approve(stakeAmount) WITHOUT setting lastActionRef; the success effect at FarmPage.tsx:119-122 runs on ANY actions.isSuccess/hash and defaults `const actionType = lastActionRef.current ?? 'stake'`. So a first-time staker's APPROVAL confirmation shows a full stake receipt ('amount: submitted?.stakeAmount ?? stakeAmount' = the typed amount, lock duration, boost) plus confetti.fire() (line 162-164) while nothing is staked. Same effect fires for extendLock (StakingCard.tsx:200), toggleAutoMaxLock (:289), revalidateBoost (:127), claimUnsettled (:221), and emergencyExit (:312) — none set lastActionRef, so each shows a stale/'stake' receipt with whatever lastActionRef held. ReceiptType 'approve' exists in useTransactionReceipt.ts:4 but is never used here.
findings.suggestion: Set lastActionRef.current = 'approve' (and per-action values) before each writeContract call, add an 'approve' branch (receipt type exists), and only confetti on real stake/claim. Guard the default: if lastActionRef is null, skip the receipt instead of assuming 'stake'.

findings.title: Copy claims 25% early-exit penalty is 'redistributed to stakers' — contract sends 100% to treasury
findings.evidence: StakingCard.tsx:448 'redistributed to stakers still farming with tegridy', BoostScheduleTable.tsx:105 'Penalty tokens are redistributed to remaining stakers — so diamond hands get rewarded', lib/copy.ts:74 earlyExitTooltip 'redistributed to stakers still farming with tegridy'. Contract: TegridyStaking.sol:1249 '@notice Early withdrawal — 25% penalty sent to treasury', :1250 'AUDIT FIX L-23: Corrected comment — penalty goes to treasury, not redistributed to stakers', :1271 safeTransfer(treasury, penalty). StakingCard's own confirm dialog at line 270 correctly says 'will be sent to treasury' — the same card contradicts itself.
findings.suggestion: Fix the three 'redistributed to stakers' strings to say treasury (additive: keep the Towelie voice, just correct the destination). This is a false financial claim that incentivizes locking under wrong assumptions.

findings.title: IL calculator computes LP value off deposit instead of HODL value — massively overstates loss
findings.evidence: ILCalculator.tsx:17-18: `const holdValue = deposit * (1 + (rPositive - 1) / 2);` then `const lpValue = deposit * (1 + il);`. IL = 2*sqrt(r)/(1+r)-1 is defined RELATIVE TO HODL, so lpValue must be holdValue*(1+il). At +50% price: code shows LP Value $989.85 vs HODL $1,250 (a $260 'loss'); correct LP value is $1,237 (a $13 IL). The calculator tells prospective LPs they lose money when price goes UP.
findings.suggestion: lpValue = holdValue * (1 + il). The IL% readout (line 12-13) is already correct; only the dollar panel is wrong.

findings.title: Raw parseEther(stakeAmount) in render path — page-killing crash reachable via Max button with dust balance
findings.evidence: FarmPage.tsx:105 `const stakeNeedsApproval = pos.allowance < (amtNum > 0 ? parseEther(stakeAmount) : 0n);` runs every render with no try/catch. The repo's own safeParseEther.ts:5-12 documents that parseEther('1e3') throws and 'the entire page goes blank' (R034 H4) — every write path was migrated, this render-path call was not. Trigger: StakingCard.tsx:347-349 Max button does setStakeAmount(String(Math.min(bal, cap))); for a wallet TOWELI balance < 1e-6 (dust), String() yields exponent notation ('1e-16'), parseFloat()>0 so the parseEther branch executes and throws → AppLayout ErrorBoundary replaces the whole page. StakingCard itself wraps the identical parse in try/catch (lines 93-98), proving the team knows the hazard.
findings.suggestion: Replace with safeParseEther(stakeAmount) ?? 0n (already imported in sibling code), or reuse StakingCard's guarded stakeWei via props.

findings.title: POOL_LAUNCH_TIMESTAMP hardcoded to 2025-03-01 — fee-derived APR/volume will be understated ~50-80x post-relaunch
findings.evidence: usePoolTVL.ts:10 `const POOL_LAUNCH_TIMESTAMP = new Date('2025-03-01').getTime() / 1000;` then :77-82 `dailyFees = totalFeesUsd / poolAgeDays` with poolAge anchored to that date. The relaunch pair/SwapFeeRouter were deployed 2026-06-06 (constants.ts comments 'RELAUNCH 2026-06-06'), so once totalETHFees > 0n the divisor is ~465 days instead of days-since-deploy, deflating Est. APR and Est. 24h Vol on LivePoolCard by the age ratio.
findings.suggestion: Anchor to the SwapFeeRouter deploy timestamp (or read first-fee block) instead of a hardcoded pre-relaunch date.

findings.title: LP 'Est. APR' and 'Reward Rate' ignore periodFinish — shows live APR after emissions end
findings.evidence: LPFarmingSection.tsx:39-47 lpApr uses lpFarm.rewardRatePerYear with no isActive check; useLPFarming.ts:59 rewardRate is the raw Synthetix-style storage value which stays non-zero after periodFinish, and :70 isActive (periodFinish > now) gates ONLY the 'LIVE' badge (LPFarmingSection.tsx:113). After the funded period lapses (memory: Sept-4 emission cliff), the section will display a positive headline APR and 'X / day' reward rate (line 145) while earned() has stopped accruing.
findings.suggestion: Zero rewardRatePerDay/Year when !isActive (or show 'period ended — awaiting refill'), matching how the contract's earned() clamps at periodFinish.

findings.title: 'Reward Pool' stat shows cumulative totalRewardsFunded as if it were remaining rewards
findings.evidence: useFarmStats.ts:40 `rewardPool: ... totalFunded ...` feeds IncentivesStrip.tsx:33 label 'Reward Pool' (💰). usePoolData.ts:34-36 in the SAME feature explicitly documents: 'totalRewardsFunded is CUMULATIVE (never decreases), so it must not be displayed as "rewards remaining"'. The honest figure rewardsRemaining (usePoolData.ts:43, balance − staked − unsettled) is computed and surfaced on TokenomicsPage.tsx:203 but not on the Farm page, whose label implies remaining funds.
findings.suggestion: Feed IncentivesStrip from pool.rewardsRemaining (already available on the page via usePoolData) or relabel to 'Total Rewards Funded'.

findings.title: No refetch after tx success — approve button stays 'Approve TOWELI' up to 30s after approval confirms
findings.evidence: FarmPage.tsx:119-167 success effect never calls pos.refetchAll(); allowance comes from useUserPosition.ts:25 refetchInterval: 30_000. After an approve confirms, stakeNeedsApproval stays true until the next poll, so the CTA still reads 'Approve TOWELI' (StakingCard.tsx:443) — users can sign a second pointless approval. Same lag applies post-stake (position card appears up to 30s late, stake form with stale input stays mounted) and post-claim. useLPFarming.ts:93 deliberately removed its refetch ('60s poll drives convergence') — 60s of stale 'Your Staked LP' after staking.
findings.suggestion: Call pos.refetchAll() / lpFarm.refetch() in the isSuccess effects (single targeted refetch is not a storm), and clear stakeAmount after a confirmed stake.

findings.title: chainId pinning inconsistent across farm read hooks — wrong-chain wallet sees an empty position
findings.evidence: useFarmStats.ts:19-21, useLPFarming.ts:42-53, usePoolTVL.ts:22-28 pin `chainId: CHAIN_ID` per entry (comment 'R043 H-062-02: chainId pin on every entry'), but usePoolData.ts:10-22, useUserPosition.ts:17-43, useRestaking.ts:19-34 and usePoints.ts:34-41 do not. On a wrong-chain wallet those reads execute against the wallet's current chain, fail/return 0n, so a user with a real position sees the fresh 'Stake TOWELI' form instead of 'Your Position' (only the WrongChainBanner hints why).
findings.suggestion: Add chainId: CHAIN_ID to the unpinned entries for consistency with the R043 pattern already applied to the sibling hooks.

findings.title: Accessibility gaps: unlinked input label, color-only selection state, no aria-pressed on lock options, no focus management in confirm flows
findings.evidence: StakingCard.tsx:345 `<label className=...>Amount</label>` has no htmlFor and the input at :355 has no id/aria-label; lock-duration buttons (:368-378) and extend-lock buttons (:180-190) convey selection purely via inline background/color (selected = black text on purple) with no aria-pressed/role=radiogroup; destructive confirm panels (withdraw :236, earlyWithdraw :262, emergencyExit :303) appear without moving focus, and the 5s auto-dismiss (FarmPage.tsx:90-91) can remove a focused dialog. AnimatedCounter values (:120,124,136) have no aria-live so claimable updates are silent to screen readers.
findings.suggestion: Wire htmlFor/id, add aria-pressed to option buttons plus a non-color selected indicator (checkmark/border weight), focus the confirm panel's cancel button on open.

findings.title: Approve confirmation wipes the typed stake amount
findings.evidence: LPFarmingSection.tsx:25-30 `useEffect(() => { if (lpFarm.isSuccess) { setLpStakeAmount(''); setLpWithdrawAmount(''); } }, [lpFarm.isSuccess]);` — lpFarm.isSuccess fires for the APPROVE tx too (useLPFarming.ts:24 covers every writeContract), so after 'Approve LP' confirms the input the user must immediately re-stake with is cleared.
findings.suggestion: Track the last action (approve vs stake/withdraw) and only clear inputs on stake/withdraw success.

findings.title: Claim/unstake receipts read live position values at confirm time — race shows 0/stale amounts
findings.evidence: FarmPage.tsx:142 claim receipt uses pos.pendingFormatted and :151 unstake uses pos.stakedFormatted at the time the receipt effect runs. The code itself acknowledges the hazard for stake ('Capture values at submission time to avoid stale closures', :69-70, submittedDataRef) but claim/unstake are not snapshotted; a 30s position poll (useUserPosition.ts:25) landing between submit and confirm zeroes them, producing a 'claimed 0 TOWELI' receipt.
findings.suggestion: Snapshot pending/staked into submittedDataRef in the claim/withdraw onClick handlers like the stake path does.

findings.title: type="number" + strip-regex silently mangles scientific-notation input ('1e5' becomes '15')
findings.evidence: StakingCard.tsx:355 `<input type="number" ... onChange={(e) => setStakeAmount(e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '').replace(/(\..*)\./g, '$1'))}` — number inputs accept 'e', so typing 1e5 yields target.value '1e5' which the regex rewrites to '15': the user wanted 100,000 and the form silently stakes 15. Same pattern in LPFarmingSection.tsx:209-212 and :270-273.
findings.suggestion: Use type="text" inputMode="decimal" (the regex already enforces decimal shape), the standard DeFi pattern.

findings.title: Swap-points getLogs scans 5M+ blocks from a pre-deploy block; failure is swallowed to 0, and logAction is a deprecated no-op
findings.evidence: usePoints.ts:73-83 `publicClient.getLogs({ ... fromBlock: 18000000n, toBlock: 'latest' })` — SwapFeeRouter deployed 2026-06-06 (constants.ts), block 18M is Sep-2023; most public RPCs reject multi-million-block getLogs ranges, and the .catch(() => setSwapCount(0)) hides it, so swap-derived points are likely always 0. Also FarmPage.tsx:159 `points.logAction(actionType, ...)` calls pointsEngine.ts:190 recordAction which is '@deprecated ... Points derived from on-chain data only' and returns unchanged data — dead call. Unverified hypothesis only on the specific RPC's range cap; the stale fromBlock and no-op are factual.
findings.suggestion: Use the router's deploy block as fromBlock (or chunk the range), and delete the dead logAction call.

findings.title: '100% to stakers' fee-share claims hardcoded while the split is governance-mutable down to 50%
findings.evidence: IncentivesStrip.tsx:36 `{ l: 'Fee Share', v: '100% to stakers' }` and ConnectPrompt.tsx:29 'earn 100% of protocol swap fees'. Verified accurate TODAY: SwapFeeRouter.sol:235 `uint256 public stakerShareBps = 10_000` default — but applyFeeSplit (:1417-1423) can lower it to 5,000 bps without any frontend change; stakerShareBps is a public view that could be read instead.
findings.suggestion: Read stakerShareBps on-chain (one extra slot in the existing usePoolTVL multicall) and render the live percentage.

findings.title: Headline TOWELI price + sparkline are frozen at page-load for the whole session when the native pair is empty
findings.evidence: useToweliPrice.ts:112-138 GeckoTerminal fallback fetch runs once (empty dep array, mounted once via app-level PriceProvider) with no interval; with the native TOWELI/WETH pair unseeded (reserves 0 → spotPriceInEth 0, :184-187) priceInUsd === apiFallbackPrice for the entire session, yet FarmStatsRow.tsx:33 renders it next to a PulseDot implying liveness. usePriceHistory.ts:31-127 likewise fetches once per mount (5-min cache) with no refresh.
findings.suggestion: Add a setInterval/refetch (e.g. 60s, matching on-chain reads) to the API fallback while the pair is unseeded.

findings.title: Withdraw-LP input not validated against staked balance — builds a reverting tx
findings.evidence: LPFarmingSection.tsx:284 disables only on `(parseFloat(lpWithdrawAmount) || 0) <= 0 || lpFarm.stakedBalance === 0n` — entering more than stakedBalanceFormatted passes the guard and submits a withdraw that reverts in-wallet. Contrast with the stake side, which pre-checks minStake at :228-236 specifically to avoid 'the wallet shows a scary revert-fallback gas estimate' (their own comment :225-227).
findings.suggestion: Add overStaked check mirroring the belowMin pattern, with a 'Max X LP' disabled-button label.

findings.title: rewardSanityBreach exported but never consumed — promised 'Verify on-chain' prompt unimplemented
findings.evidence: useRestaking.ts:163-165 doc: 'R075: true when an RPC quoted impossible reward numbers — UI should prompt "Verify on-chain" instead of showing the values.' FarmPage.tsx:269-338 renders the restaking panel without reading rewardSanityBreach; on breach the hook zeroes the values (:72-73) so users just see 0.0000 pending with no explanation.
findings.suggestion: Render a small 'reward data failed sanity check — verify on Etherscan' notice when restaking.rewardSanityBreach is true.

findings.title: LOCK_OPTIONS duplicated in three files — divergence risk for a financial parameter
findings.evidence: Identical 7-entry arrays at FarmPage.tsx:40-48, StakingCard.tsx:19-27, BoostScheduleTable.tsx:8-16. A future edit to one (e.g. adding a 3-year tier) silently desyncs the form, the extend-lock picker, and the schedule table.
findings.suggestion: Export once from lib/constants.ts next to MIN/MAX_LOCK_DURATION.

findings.title: No USD values anywhere in the position/stake flow despite live price in context
findings.evidence: StakingCard.tsx:120 (Staked), :136 (Claimable), :398 (Effective stake) and the Projected Earnings grid (:413-427) are all TOWELI-only; useTOWELIPrice is already consumed on the page (FarmPage.tsx:61) and in LPFarmingSection. FarmStatsRow.tsx:18 labels a raw token count 'Total Value Locked' (useFarmStats.ts:36 returns 'X TOWELI', no $ conversion).
findings.suggestion: Add ≈$ subtexts under staked/claimable/projection numbers and a USD TVL figure — Yearn/Beefy/Aave all dual-denominate.

findings.title: Pre-connect visitors can't see the boost schedule, pools, or stats
findings.evidence: FarmPage.tsx:171-186 — the !isConnected return renders only IncentivesStrip + ConnectPrompt; FarmStatsRow, the pool cards, LP-farming stats and BoostScheduleTable (all read-only public data) are hidden until connect. Uniswap/Yearn show the full read-only market view pre-connect.
findings.suggestion: Additively include FarmStatsRow + BoostScheduleTable + LivePoolCard in the disconnected branch (data hooks are connection-independent), keeping ConnectPrompt for the action card slot.

findings.title: Boosted rate labeled 'APY' but the math is simple APR (no compounding) — rest of page says APR
findings.evidence: BoostScheduleTable.tsx:52 `{(baseApr * b / 10000).toFixed(1)}% APY` and :85-88 mobile 'APY' label — the figure is aprNum × boost, straight-line. IncentivesStrip (:28 'Staking APR'), FarmStatsRow (:20 'Base APR') and StakingCard (:430 'base APR') all say APR.
findings.suggestion: Rename to APR (or add a real compounding toggle).

findings.title: '🔥 HOT' badge hardcoded on a pool that is currently unseeded/empty
findings.evidence: LivePoolCard.tsx:29 `<PoolStatusBadge status="hot" />` unconditionally; the native pair has never been seeded post-relaunch (usePoolTVL returns tvlFormatted '–' when reserves are absent, usePoolTVL.ts:43-44), so an empty pool with dash TVL is badged HOT — the same vaporware signal poolConfig.ts:31-39 was cleaned up to avoid.
findings.suggestion: Derive the badge from poolData (e.g. 'live' once TVL > 0, hide otherwise).

findings.title: 5s confirm auto-dismiss timer resets on every parent rerender
findings.evidence: FarmPage.tsx:81-82 setConfirm is a new function identity each render; useAutoReset.ts:13-17 lists `setter` in its effect deps, so every FarmPage rerender (15s pendingETH poll, 30s position poll, price updates) clears and re-arms the full 5000ms timeout — the withdraw confirm can stay open well past 5s, and the dismissal moment is unpredictable.
findings.suggestion: Wrap setConfirm in useCallback (stable identity) or key the effect off a timestamp captured when the confirm opened.

findings.title: Fallback 24h volume is invented from a guessed turnover ratio, not observed swaps
findings.evidence: usePoolTVL.ts:93-102 — when no fee data exists, vol24h = tvl × {1-4%} bucket ratio, then displayed on LivePoolCard.tsx:44 as 'Est. 24h Vol'. It is flagged '~'/'(est.)' and the card says 'estimated from on-chain reserves' (:48), but the number has no relationship to actual trading; with the protocol's stated honesty bar, a synthetic turnover stat is the weakest figure on the page.
findings.suggestion: Show '— no volume data yet' until totalSwaps/totalETHFees exist (totalSwaps is already read at index 4 and unused, :71).

findings.title: Gallery nav button is dead; 'g' shortcut also does nothing
findings.evidence: Clicked the header 'Gallery' button by coordinate AND via accessibility ref (ref_12) on prod — URL stayed /nakamigos/nakamigos/, Floor tab stayed highlighted. Pressed 'g' (documented in the Keys overlay as 'Go to Gallery') — nothing. Direct URL /nakamigos/nakamigos/gallery works and renders a full Gallery page with the Gallery tab highlighted. Also, clicking 'Gallery' from the chat tab routed to the Floor/Listings route ('/'), so the button's target appears wired to the wrong route.

findings.title: Detail-modal hero image never loads — shows letter placeholder while grid thumbnails work
findings.evidence: Nakamigos #5 modal showed 'N #5' placeholder (while the same token's favorites-card thumbnail rendered fine), Jungle Bay #4522 showed 'J #4522', GNSS #5907 showed 'G #5907' — all stayed placeholders for the full 20-60s each modal was open. findings.title: WalletConnect listed three times; Safe/Base/MetaMask share one generic emoji icon
findings.evidence: Clicking 'Connect wallet' from chat opened a modal listing: Safe, WalletConnect (QR code · Mobile wallets), Base Account, MetaMask, WalletConnect, WalletConnect, Phantom — three identical WalletConnect rows. Safe, Base Account and MetaMask all show the same money-bag emoji instead of wallet logos.

findings.title: Splash gate (~10-14s + mandatory click) replays on EVERY full page load, even mid-session deep links and 404s

findings.page: NFT detail modal header (junglebay + gnssart, prod)
findings.title: Identical unlabeled address '0x255d...1963' shown in modal header across different collections — contradicts the contract field below

findings.evidence: Hub header shows orange '• DEMO' where collection pages show green '• LIVE — Real active listings via OpenSea'. Hovering produces no tooltip; JS dump found no title attr.
