findings.title: Tradermigos deep-link enter gate is dead - CLICK TO ENTER does not respond, visitor is permanently stuck
findings.evidence: Fresh browser context, direct goto /nakamigos/nakamigos/listings: TRADERMIGOS 'CLICK TO ENTER' gate appears (span at rect x339,y633,143x14 at 820px). 8+ clicks dead-center on that span plus viewport-center clicks over 60s of observation never dismissed it (probe2/probe3 logs: body text identical 'CLICK TO ENTER...' from t=3s through t=60s). Same rect-click on /nakamigos ROOT dismisses its gate immediately (proceeds to 'RENDERING HOUDINI SCULPT' loading). Reproduced on all 4 deep routes (listings/analytics/portfolio/trades), both viewports. Screenshot of the stuck gate: ipad_nakamigos-nakamigos-listings_1.png (capture3 pass). When the session has previously entered via the main app at /, deep routes skip the gate entirely - so this hits exactly the highest-value visitor: someone following a shared link to a listing page.
findings.suggestion: Make the deep-route gate's click handler work (or skip the gate on sub-routes the way an entered session does). Likely the gate component mounted on sub-routes is missing its onClick wiring that the root route has.

findings.title: /api/opensea collections/{slug}/stats returns 400 for every collection - hub card stats stuck as skeletons forever
findings.evidence: Network log: '400 https://tegridyfarms.vercel.app/api/opensea?path=collections%2Fnakamigos%2Fstats' (also junglebay, gnssart) on every page load, every retry, both viewports - it is a 400 (bad request), not a rate-limit. Visible consequence: ipad_nakamigos_1.png / desktop_nakamigos_2.png show the Nakamigos collection card with FLOOR/VOLUME/OWNERS/SUPPLY as gray skeleton bars that never resolve while GNSS Art and Jungle Bay resolve (via fallback source); listings header 'LISTED' shows '-' (ipad_nakamigos-nakamigos-listings_1.png).
findings.suggestion: The proxy or the caller is malforming the stats path (400 = rejected before OpenSea). Check api/opensea allowlist/path validation for 'collections/{slug}/stats'; add an error state to the stat tiles instead of infinite skeleton.

findings.title: Analytics and Portfolio deep links render the Floor tab instead of their own tab
findings.evidence: ipad_nakamigos-nakamigos-analytics_1.png and ipad_nakamigos-nakamigos-portfolio_1.png both show headline 'FLOOR & LISTINGS - 778 Nakamigos currently listed for sale across marketplaces' with the 'Floor' tab highlighted in the nav; desktop_nakamigos-nakamigos-analytics_1.png and desktop_nakamigos-nakamigos-portfolio_1.png show the same. Meanwhile /trades deep-links correctly to its 'P2P Trades' content (ipad_nakamigos-nakamigos-trades_1.png), proving sub-route rendering works for some tabs.
findings.suggestion: Route the analytics/portfolio paths to their tabs; if portfolio is wallet-gated, show a connect prompt like /trades does rather than silently swapping to Floor.

findings.title: Own /api/opensea rate limiter 429s under one normal browsing session - listings grid dead-ends in an endless 'Fetching live listings...' skeleton with no error state
findings.evidence: 429s from tegridyfarms.vercel.app/api/opensea (events, listings/collection/nakamigos/best, offers, stats) on listings/analytics/portfolio/trades during single-context sequential page visits (results JSON: 4-12 fails per route, both viewports). UI consequence: ipad_nakamigos-nakamigos-listings_1.png shows 'Fetching live listings from marketplaces...' with a skeleton grid still unresolved 20+s later; desktop_nakamigos-nakamigos-analytics_1.png same; ipad_nakamigos-nakamigos-portfolio_3.png shows an entire grid of 'N' placeholder thumbnails (prices loaded, images throttled). Caveat: this audit's repeated runs contributed to the limiter pressure, but tripping it within ~6 page loads in 3 minutes is itself too tight for one real user with browsing momentum.
findings.suggestion: Raise/scope the per-IP limit (or batch+cache the per-page request fan-out: stats is requested 3-8x per page), and replace infinite skeletons with an error/retry state when the proxy 429s.

findings.title: RPC failover rotation includes endpoints the app cannot use - eth.merkle.io blocked by own CSP, eth.llamarpc.com fails CORS preflight
findings.evidence: Console on every route, both viewports: "Connecting to 'https://eth.merkle.io/' violates the following Content Security Policy directive: connect-src 'self' https://rpc.ankr.com https://*.publicnode.com https://*.llamarpc.com ..." repeated continuously (capture4 portfolio route logged 209 console errors in ~30s, mostly this), plus 'Access to fetch at https://eth.llamarpc.com/ ... blocked by CORS policy: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header'. These are wasted failover attempts on every data refresh.
findings.suggestion: Either add eth.merkle.io to connect-src or drop it from the wagmi/viem transport list; drop or replace eth.llamarpc.com (provider-side CORS rejection). This also cuts the constant console noise that masks real errors.

findings.title: Enter gate + art intro replays on every full page load - no persistence of the entered state
findings.evidence: Same browser context, gate passed by click at /; subsequent goto of any route shows the full gate/intro again (probe log: /farm at t=24s after fresh load shows 'TEGRIDY FARMS - CLICK TO ENTER' again, probe_farm_t24s.png). Every reload or direct link costs a click plus several seconds of intro before content. SPA client-side nav avoids it, but refreshes/deep links always pay it.
findings.suggestion: Persist 'entered' in localStorage/sessionStorage and skip (or fast-forward) the gate for returning sessions; keep the full experience for true first visits.

findings.title: Connect Wallet prompt rendered bare over busy artwork - near illegible at 820
findings.evidence: ipad_dashboard_1.png: 'Connect Wallet / View your positions, rewards, and earnings' is drawn directly over the camo-pattern jungle-military art with no scrim or card - the heading dissolves into the camouflage. desktop_dashboard_1.png has the same pattern (slightly better at 1440). Contrast with ipad_farm_1.png where the identical prompt gets a proper dark rounded card and is perfectly readable.
findings.suggestion: Wrap the dashboard connect prompt in the same dark card component /farm and /nft-finance use.

findings.title: 820px gets a denser grid than desktop - 5 NFT columns at 820 vs 4 at 1440, with sub-44px touch targets
findings.evidence: ipad_nakamigos-nakamigos-analytics_1.png: floor grid renders 5 columns at 820px (cards ~150px wide, 'Connect & Buy' buttons roughly 100x22 CSS px, 8-9px mono labels) on a context with isMobile/hasTouch. desktop_nakamigos-nakamigos-listings_1.png renders 4 larger columns at 1440. The tablet gets a squeezed-desktop treatment, inverted density, and tap targets well under the 44px touch guideline. The top tab row (Floor/Gallery/Traits/Activity/My NFTs/More) is similarly tiny at 820.

findings.title: Page subtitles and inactive tab labels are low-contrast over bright artwork
findings.evidence: ipad_swap_1.png / desktop_swap_1.png: subtitle 'Trade ETH <-> TOWELI via Uniswap V2 with custom slippage controls' is dark gray text directly on the busy market-scene art; inactive tabs 'Liquidity / DCA / Alerts' are white-on-light-art. ipad_nft-finance_1.png: subtitle over the bright framed painting. ipad_tokenomics_1.png: subtitle 'TOWELI token economics and protocol transparency' same issue.

findings.title: Floating mascot chat toast overlaps content at the bottom-right on every page

Don't forget your towel.' toast plus avatar sits over the earnings calculator's 'Start farming' CTA; ipad_home_2.png: it covers a third of a collection card; it reappears with new copy on every route (farm/swap/dashboard/nft-finance/community/tokenomics/premium screenshots all show it).

findings.title: /premium lands on the 'Gold Card' tab whose content is a SOON placeholder instead of the live Points tab
findings.evidence: ipad_premium_1.png and desktop_premium_1.png: tab bar is Points | Gold Card | History | Changelog with 'Gold Card' active, showing 'SOON - Gold Card isn't live yet ... once the PremiumAccess contract is deployed'. First impression of the page is an empty feature.

findings.title: GeckoTerminal price fetch fails from the browser (ERR_FAILED) - price/FDV depend on fallback
findings.evidence: Console on /tokenomics and /premium: 'Access to fetch at https://api.geckoterminal.com/api/v2/simple/networks/eth/token_price/0x420698...f9d ... ERR_FAILED'. The page still shows PRICE $0.00004132 / FDV $41,322.75 (ipad_tokenomics_1.png), so a fallback works, but the primary source errors on every load.

good: Zero horizontal overflow anywhere: scrollWidth == innerWidth (820/820 and 1440/1440) on all 13 routes in both viewports across every capture pass - no mobile/tablet overflow bugs at all.

820px gets a genuinely thoughtful tablet layout on the main app, not a stretched phone view: full nav bar (Dashboard/Farm/Trade/More + Connect) fits without a hamburger, farm stat tiles reflow 1-row -> 2-col, How It Works / Ecosystem hold a readable 3-col, the earnings calculator becomes a clean full-width card, footer keeps 5 columns comfortably (ipad_home_1/2/3.png, ipad_farm_1.png).

1440 is clearly the design sweet spot: tokenomics does a proper 2-col donut + emission-schedule split, farm shows all 5 stat tiles in one row, the nakamigos hub is a balanced 3-card row, and nothing feels stretched (desktop_tokenomics_1.png, desktop_farm_1.png, desktop_nakamigos_1.png) - the ultrawide problems the live agents found do not exist at 1440.

The art-gallery splash itself scales correctly at both widths: full-bleed portrait at 820, letterboxed at 1440 with no cropping of the artwork (ipad_home_splash.png, desktop_home_splash.png); the particle-dissolve transitions render smoothly.
Honesty surfaces render cleanly: 'Gold Card isn't live yet - SOON', contract list with Live/Pending/Deployed badges, 'early-TVL bootstrap rate' APR explainer, risk-disclosure footer on every page.
Tokenomics data layer works: supply donut + legend, emission schedule (71,220 TOWELI/day, ~89 days), contract addresses with copy buttons all populate at both widths.

Tradermigos at 1440 is a polished pro UI when data loads: 4-col listing grid with prices, LIVE sales ticker, onboarding tour ('1 OF 5 Gallery... Skip/Next') renders centered and dismissible (desktop_nakamigos-nakamigos-listings_1.png from the capture2 pass).
Welcome onboarding modal and telemetry consent banner both render correctly positioned and dismissible at 820 and 1440 (probe_farm_afterclick.png).
viewport:tablet-desktop.splashAndTransitions: The first-visit splash is an art carousel ending in a TEGRIDY FARMS / CLICK TO ENTER gate; it renders correctly at both 820 (full-bleed) and 1440 (letterboxed) with no cropping. However it is NOT first-visit-gated in practice: it replays on every full page load (verified in one context: entered at /, then a fresh load of /farm showed the full gate again at t=24s). Route content appears via a particle-dissolve transition taking roughly 8-12s after the gate click. Tradermigos has a second, separate CLICK TO ENTER gate; its root-page gate works but on deep routes the button is dead (high finding). Loading skeletons exist (stat bars, listing cards) but several have no terminal error state and can spin forever when the opensea proxy 400s/429s. The main app's welcome tour modal and telemetry banner appear after the gate and dismiss cleanly.
viewport:tablet-desktop.consoleAndNetwork: Console (every route, both viewports): dominated by two systemic errors - (1) CSP violation 'Connecting to https://eth.merkle.io/ violates connect-src' repeated continuously (the RPC failover list includes an endpoint the CSP blocks; up to 209 console errors in ~30s on the Tradermigos portfolio route), (2) CORS preflight failure on https://eth.llamarpc.com/ (provider sends no Access-Control-Allow-Origin). Plus https://api.geckoterminal.com/.../token_price/0x4206... ERR_FAILED on /tokenomics and /premium. Zero pageerrors (no JS exceptions) on any route. Network: /api/opensea?path=collections/{nakamigos|junglebay|gnssart}/stats returns 400 on every call (a request bug, not rate limiting); /api/opensea events/listings/offers paths return 429 within a single browsing session (5-12 failures per Tradermigos route), starving the listings grid and NFT images. Main-app routes (/farm, /swap, etc.) had zero 4xx/5xx.

findings.title: Connect-wall copy promises live features, but all 4 sections are pre-deploy — honesty is revealed only AFTER wallet connect
findings.evidence: Logged out, every tab shows only a ConnectPrompt with live-sounding copy: 'Connect to lend & borrow TOWELI', 'Connect to borrow against your NFTs', 'Connect to trade NFTs on bonding curves', 'Connect to the NFT launchpad'. But in src/lib/constants.ts TEGRIDY_LENDING_ADDRESS (line 47), TEGRIDY_NFT_LENDING_ADDRESS (line 54), TEGRIDY_RESTAKING_ADDRESS (line 7) and TEGRIDY_LAUNCHPAD_V2_ADDRESS (line 67) are all 0x000...000. The honest messaging ('Lending contracts are being audited and will be deployed soon' amber banner in LendingSection.tsx:1855-1861, 'NFT AMM contracts are being finalized' AMMSection.tsx:2661-2668, 'Launchpad V2 factory not deployed yet' LaunchpadSection.tsx:98-101, FeatureNotDeployed 'NFT lending isn't live yet' LendingPage.tsx:238) renders ONLY in the isConnected branch (LendingPage.tsx:219-242). A user connects a wallet expecting to transact and then discovers everything is 'coming soon' — a bait-and-switch trust gap.
findings.suggestion: Additive fix: surface the same pre-deploy status on the logged-out gate — e.g. add the amber 'being audited, deploying soon' line and/or a small SOON badge to each ConnectPrompt (SECTION_PROMPTS in LendingPage.tsx:28-49), and add 'Coming soon' micro-badges to the affected tab pills. Keep the connect CTA; just set expectations before asking for a wallet.

findings.title: Zero market/preview data logged out — page objective unfulfilled for visitors
findings.evidence: Each tab renders only a 560px connect card (ConnectPrompt.tsx). No collections, loan terms, APR/LTV figures, pool stats, TVL, or live/upcoming drops are visible without a wallet. The codebase already HAS explorable disconnected-friendly UI (StatsBar, HowItWorks accordion, offers table, BondingCurveChart preview, blurred mock-offer ComingSoonState in LendingSection.tsx:350-445 and AMMSection.tsx:2581-2644) but it is unreachable logged out. NFTfi/Gondi/Blend show offer books, collection lists and APRs without connecting; launchpads (Magic Eden/OpenSea drops) show upcoming drops + countdowns logged out — drop discovery is inherently a logged-out activity.
findings.suggestion: Render each section's read-only view (stats bar, HowItWorks, offer tables, bonding-curve explainer, drops list) for disconnected users, and gate only the transactional buttons behind connect. The components already accept a 'deployed' prop, so most of this is unlocking existing UI.

findings.title: No desktop nav link to NFT Finance — page is orphaned from header and footer
findings.evidence: Header nav contains Dashboard / Farm / Trade / More / Tradermigos; the More menu contains only Gallery, Tegridy Score, Tokenomics, Treasury (verified via read_page menuitem refs). findings.suggestion: Add 'NFT Finance' to the desktop More menu (or as a top-level item) and to the footer PRODUCT column, optionally with a SOON badge while contracts are pre-deploy, matching the mobile bottom-nav.

findings.title: Token Lending gate copy contradicts the section's own mechanics (TOWELI vs ETH)
findings.evidence: Gate headline: 'Connect to lend & borrow TOWELI' / 'Supply TOWELI for yield' (LendingPage.tsx:30-32). But the overview card says 'Lend ETH against staking positions' (LendingPage.tsx:55) and the post-connect HowItWorks says 'Lenders deposit ETH and set their terms' with TVL denominated in ETH (LendingSection.tsx:1862-1873, mock offers in ETH at :358-363). Also the generic 'lending' DEFAULTS in ConnectPrompt.tsx:38-43 mentions 'JBAY Gold NFTs' — a collection not referenced anywhere else on this page (JBAC/Nakamigos/GNSS are the stated set).

findings.title: ARIA: tabs reference tabpanels that don't exist; no arrow-key tab navigation
findings.evidence: All 4 [role=tab] buttons have aria-controls='nft-finance-panel-{key}' but document.querySelectorAll('[role="tabpanel"]').length === 0 when disconnected (verified via in-page JS) — the tabpanel id/role only renders in the isConnected branch (LendingPage.tsx:228-229), so aria-controls dangles for every logged-out user. Pressing ArrowRight with a tab focused does not move selection/focus (verified live); tabs have no roving tabindex (tabindex null on all).
findings.suggestion: Give the ConnectPrompt wrapper the role='tabpanel' + id when disconnected, and add standard arrow-key roving-tabindex behavior to the tablist.

findings.title: First-visit splash runs ~15-19s with no visible Skip affordance
findings.evidence: Fresh navigation played a multi-phase animated splash (banana-tape art market scene → particle starfield → particle ring → golden kaleidoscope shatter with TEGRIDY title) lasting roughly 15-19 seconds before page content appeared. Only control shown is a small mute/speaker icon top-right. A click anywhere may skip (page appeared shortly after my click at ~14s) but nothing labels this. Repeat-visit behavior is good: sessionStorage 'tf_loaded' suppresses it for the session, and replay is available via the logo-monkey easter-egg button (title='Replay splash screen (full reload)').
findings.suggestion: Keep the art splash (it's a brand asset) but add an explicit 'Skip' label/affordance (e.g. 'Click to skip' hint or a Skip button after 2s) so first-time visitors heading to a finance page aren't held for ~15s.

findings.title: Towelie mascot sprite occludes the 'Protocol Active $...' price chip
findings.evidence: Zoomed screenshot of region (1000,880)-(1246,952): the chip renders 'Protocol Active $0...' and the Towelie character sprite sits on top of the price text, clipping it. Both elements are fixed bottom-right with overlapping bounds.

findings.title: Light mode: 'NFT Finance' h1 turns dark navy over dark painting art — weak contrast
findings.evidence: After toggling light mode, the serif h1 renders in a dark indigo/navy over the dark gallery-painting backdrop (zoom region 416,60-830,290): the title visibly sinks into the art, while the subtitle stays white and readable. Dark mode h1 (white) is fine.
findings.suggestion: Keep the art; add a text-shadow/scrim or keep the h1 light-on-dark in both themes since the backdrop art is dark in both.

findings.title: Primary RPC eth.llamarpc.com is down (503/521) and still probed in prod
findings.evidence: Network log on load: POST https://eth.llamarpc.com/ → 503 and OPTIONS → 521, with successful failover to ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com and rpc.ankr.com (both 200). Page data unaffected. HEAD already demotes llamarpc to last-resort with rank:true (src/lib/wagmi.ts:12-21, comment dated 2026-06-11), but the live prod bundle still hits it on first load ('first hits still pay' per the code comment).
findings.suggestion: Deploy the HEAD wagmi.ts demotion to prod. Also note src/nakamigos/components/OnChainProfile.jsx:158 and WhaleIntelligence.jsx:363 still hard-code llamarpc as their ONLY provider — those surfaces have no failover.

findings.title: Background art pops in 5-14s after content with no placeholder
findings.evidence: On reload the page rendered as a flat dark void (#060c1a) with the connect card; the full-bleed gallery art (e.g. /splash/new/3.avif and page bg) appeared abruptly ~5-14s later depending on load (observed twice: absent at 8s, present at 14s). No blur-up/LQIP placeholder or fade-from-dominant-color.

findings.title: Overview intro has 3 cards but the page has 4 sections — Launchpad omitted; tab subtitles defined but never rendered

Separately, SECTIONS defines subtitles ('Staking + Restake', 'Generic NFTs', 'Bonding curves') at LendingPage.tsx:18-23 that are never rendered in the tab bar (render at :194-216 uses only {label}) — 'Staking + Restake' is the ONLY navigational hint that restaking lives under Token Lending, and it's invisible.

findings.title: Inactive tab pills have no hover state

findings.suggestion: Add a subtle hover treatment (e.g. bg-white/5 or text-white/70 → white) to inactive pills.

findings.title: 'Dismiss overview' control is nearly invisible (10px, 30% white, over busy art)

It works (persists via localStorage 'tegridy-nft-finance-intro-dismissed', verified across reload) but fails contrast and affordance.

findings.title: Overview card buttons exposed without accessible names
findings.evidence: read_page (interactive filter) listed the three intro cards as anonymous 'button' elements (ref_10/11/12, no name), while every other control on the page has a label. The m.button wraps art + text divs (LendingPage.tsx:140-169); the accessibility tree is not picking up a name.
findings.suggestion: Add aria-label={card.title} (e.g. 'Open Token Lending') to the intro card buttons.

findings.title: Ultrawide: functional area is a single ~560px card in a 1710px viewport — art carries the width, density is very low
findings.evidence: On the maximized ultrawide window (1710px CSS viewport), the entire interactive surface logged-out is one max-w-[560px] connect card (ConnectPrompt.tsx:68) centered in the hero; the full-bleed museum art fills the rest, so nothing looks broken or over-stretched (line lengths stay comfortable, no empty white gutters). findings.title: Splash-replay easter egg is an unlabeled 28px button on the logo monkey
findings.evidence: button title='Replay splash screen (full reload)' is a 28x28px hit area at (274,13) directly over the logo mark, discoverable only by hovering for the native tooltip. live:nft-finance.splashAndTransitions: First visit: multi-phase animated splash (art market scene → particle starfield → ring → golden kaleidoscope with TEGRIDY wordmark) lasting ~15-19s — beautiful but long, with only a mute icon and no labeled Skip (click-to-skip seems to work but is undiscoverable). findings.title: 'Verified on Etherscan' claims are false — live contracts are NOT source-verified

findings.title: Latent mispricing: UI advertises -10/-20/-30% plan discounts the contract does not implement
findings.evidence: PremiumPage.tsx:14-19 defines discounts; lines 63-66/253-258 display discounted totals and a struck-through full price. But contracts/src/PremiumAccess.sol:250 charges `uint256 cost = monthlyFeeToweli * months;` — no discount — and usePremiumAccess.ts:79-107 approves/passes maxCost = full undiscounted cost. So the user is shown e.g. a 30%-off '1 Year' total, the Approve button label shows the discounted figure (PremiumPage.tsx:365), yet the wallet approval and on-chain charge are the full amount. Also `canAfford` (line 67) checks the discounted figure, so a user can pass the check and still revert on transferFrom. Currently unreachable (PREMIUM_ACCESS_ADDRESS zeroed, FeatureNotDeployed renders), but this goes live the day the address is restored.
findings.suggestion: Remove the discount tiers from PLANS (or implement discounts contract-side before redeploy). Make displayed total = monthlyFee × months exactly.

findings.title: Advertised points mechanics are dead code: streaks, daily visits, and claim points can never accrue
findings.evidence: LeaderboardPage.tsx:171-185 advertises 'Claim Rewards +15', 'Daily Visit +5' and 'Streak multipliers: 7d = 1.5x, 14d = 2x, 30d = 3x', and the banner (line 42) says 'The streak counter is computed locally from your visit cadence.' findings.suggestion: Either remove streak/daily-visit/claim rows from 'How Points Work' and the streak stat tiles, or reinstate a visit recorder. Document the actual formula (lock-days and LP-balance bonuses).

findings.title: Swap-count log scan likely fails silently on public RPCs (4.7M-block eth_getLogs)
findings.evidence: usePoints.ts:73-84 calls publicClient.getLogs({ fromBlock: 18000000n, toBlock: 'latest' }) — a ~4.7M block range. Most public/free RPC providers cap getLogs ranges (commonly 10k blocks) and the .catch() maps any failure to swapCount 0, so swap points and the First Swap/Degen badges silently never trigger. Environment-dependent (depends on the configured RPC's limits) — unverified at runtime but the hardcoded fromBlock also predates the June 2026 relaunch deployment by years.
findings.suggestion: Start from the SwapFeeRouter deploy block and chunk the range, or read a per-user counter from the contract/indexer instead.

findings.title: Section anchor deep-links are declared but almost certainly don't scroll

findings.title: 5-tab bar is extremely tight on small phones

findings.title: No-op hover styles (text-white hover:text-white) on multiple links

findings.title: useBlockNumber({watch:true}) keeps a per-block subscription alive for one caption line
findings.evidence: TreasuryPage.tsx:89 watches every mainnet block (~12s polling/WS) solely to render 'as of block #N' (line 205-209); all data reads refresh on 60s intervals anyway.

good: Tab-merge architecture is correct and clean: all three hosts (LearnPage/ActivityPage/InfoPage) derive the active tab purely from location.pathname (R007 Pattern A — no state, no effects), every legacy URL (/tokenomics, /lore, /security, /faq, /leaderboard, /premium, /history, /changelog, /treasury, /contracts, /risks, /terms, /privacy) routes to the right tab per App.tsx:143-167, and redirects (/learn, /trade, /grants, etc.) keep old links alive. Deep-link selection verified correct for all 13 merged routes.

AdminPage security posture is genuinely strong: fail-closed WrongChainScreen on chain mismatch, owner() read pinned to the canonical chain with 10s refetch + refetchOnWindowFocus, refetchOwner() forced before every write, chainId pinned on writes, TypedConfirmation typed-phrase gate on pause/unpause, and an identity chip row (role/chain/wallet + manual Refresh role). Gating is on-chain owner() comparison — no client-side allowlist to leak, /admin is fail-closed for everyone else.

TreasuryPage is the model transparency page: revenue split read live from stakerShareBps/polShareBps (explicitly replacing a previous hardcoded 70/20/10 'lie' per the in-code audit note), a red 'treasury rotation pending' banner that compares on-chain router.treasury() against the frontend constant (self-detecting address drift), an amber router-paused banner, an oracle-stale banner, an as-of-block caption, and a schema-validated recent-transactions feed merging normal + internal transfers with dedup.

HistoryPage hardening: zod schema (hash/addr/digit regexes) applied to fresh AND cached rows so a poisoned proxy response can't reach a clickable href, AbortController lifecycle, 5-min localStorage cache, day-grouping with a minute ticker for Today/Yesterday labels, client pagination (25/page), CSV export with proper quoting, BigInt-precise gas math, and humanized proxy/NOTOK error normalization with an Etherscan fallback link.

usePoolData honesty pass is well done: rewards-remaining derived from balanceOf − totalStaked − totalUnsettledRewards (not the cumulative totalRewardsFunded), documented periodFinish derivation, and APR math that preserves precision with a separate aprNum to avoid parseFloat-on-comma-string bugs.

RisksPage is best-in-class honesty for this market segment: a protocol-specific risk register with Active/Mitigated statuses (single-EOA admin, no paid audit, IP/parody exposure, single maintainer), a complete limits-and-caps table with rationale per parameter, and a fresh 'June 11, 2026 (post-relaunch honesty pass)' date.

isDeployed() gating discipline: PremiumPage renders FeatureNotDeployed instead of a live subscribe flow against 0x0; ContractsPage routes undeployed entries to a 'pending deploy' path that suppresses stale notes; navConfig.ts credibility-gates whole nav sections (NFT Finance/Community/Premium) so the nav never promotes dark features while URLs stay routable.

The /premium cat-photo CRIT is properly resolved: PremiumPage.tsx:107-133 replaced the stray art-studio photo override with a branded inline-SVG Gold Card glyph; plan/cost math is BigInt-only for display (no float drift).

FAQ page quality: JSON-LD FAQPage structured data injected/cleaned up properly, correct accordion ARIA (aria-expanded/aria-controls/region/labelledby), search with clear button and empty state, and honest answers post-honesty-pass ('There is no paid third-party audit yet — we don't claim one').

App shell: route-level code splitting with per-page skeletons, RouteErrorBoundary preventing white screens, LazyMotion strict + domAnimation to keep the motion bundle lean, art-studio tree-shaken out of prod with a redirect.

ArtImg primitive: layout-reserving default width/height (CLS prevention), decoding=async, error fallback to placeholder, and deterministic pageArt rotation that gracefully handles unknown pageIds and deleted overrides.

pointsEngine defense-in-depth: on-chain points authoritative with localStorage as a validated cache only (typed validatePointsData, clamps, MAX caps), self-referral guards, and explicit deprecation of client-side point recording (the security posture is right — only the UI copy lagged behind, flagged separately).
missingVsBestInClass: Tokenomics: no circulating supply / market cap (only FDV), no burned-supply stat despite 25.8% burned being a headline asset, no holders count, no 'Add TOWELI to wallet' (wallet_watchAsset) button, no emissions-over-time chart, no links to CoinGecko/DEXTools alongside GeckoTerminal — table stakes on a Dexscreener-grade token page.

Leaderboard: no actual multi-user ranking (honestly acknowledged, gated on the Ponder indexer becoming publicly queryable) — until then there is no social comparison loop at all; competitors ship at least a top-N snapshot or percentile estimate.

History: no type/status filter chips, no date-range filter, no ERC-20 token-transfer view (only normal txs), no USD value column, no pending-transaction surfacing; CSV export and pagination exist (good) but Blur/OpenSea-grade activity feeds offer filtering and live updates.

Changelog: no per-release deep links/anchors, no RSS/atom or subscribe affordance, no data source (hardcoded TSX array) — best-in-class changelogs are generated from markdown/releases and link to the shipped artifacts.

Security page: no live verification-status read, no security.txt, no direct security contact (email/PGP), no link to on-chain monitoring/alerting status, no audit-firm engagement timeline; the page is static prose where Aave/Uniswap-grade pages show living status.

Treasury: ETH-only balance — treasury TOWELI/other token holdings absent, no historical treasury-balance chart, no inflow/outflow categorization or runway-vs-opex view (notable since self-sustain economics are the stated strategy).
Contracts: no ABI download/copy links, no deployment date + deploy-tx link per contract, no per-contract 'add to wallet/watch' helpers, no diff/changelog when an address rotates.

findings.title: Lightbox opens permanently invisible — entrance animation frozen at opacity 0
findings.evidence: Clicking any artwork card dims the page but shows NOTHING: no image, no Prev/Close/Next. DOM inspection shows the lightbox container (fixed inset-0 z-50) mounted with image complete (sword-of-love.jpg, naturalWidth 945, centered rect 508-1404px) and buttons present, but the content wrapper `.relative.z-10.max-w-4xl` has inline style `opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.95)` that never advances. Polled 6x over 3s on localhost:5173: stuck at `opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.975546)` — animation starts then freezes mid-flight. Reproduced 3x on prod and on dev HEAD. Escape/backdrop-click do close it, so users just see a dim flash and a dead screen.
findings.suggestion: The framer-motion (or similar) enter animation on the lightbox content wrapper never completes — check for a stalled `animate` (e.g., whileInView on a fixed element, a paused animation frame loop, or a transition with no progress driver). The core interaction of the gallery is unusable; fix before anything else on this page.

findings.title: Page is unreachable from any navigation surface (orphaned)
findings.evidence: Header nav = Dashboard, Farm, Trade, More, Tradermigos. More menu (read via accessibility tree) = Gallery, Tegridy Score(/leaderboard), Tokenomics, Treasury. Footer Product/Resources columns list Dashboard, Farm, Trade, Points, Tradermigos, Tokenomics, Gallery, Lore, History, Changelog, FAQ, Contracts, Treasury — /community appears nowhere. Only direct URL reaches it.
findings.suggestion: Add Community to the More menu (an 'Engage' group already exists there) and to the footer Product column.

findings.title: All four tabs are a hard connect-wall logged-out — zero read-only content
findings.evidence: Governance, Bounties, Vote Incentives (?section=bribes), and Gauge Voting all render the identical small card 'Connect your wallet to participate' + Connect Wallet button. Total page body text is 793 characters. No proposals list, no bounty board preview, no bribe-market data, no gauge weights — nothing to evaluate before connecting.
findings.suggestion: Best-in-class governance/vote-market UIs (Tally, Snapshot, Votium, Hidden Hand) show all market/proposal data read-only and only gate ACTIONS behind connect. Render each tab's data publicly and gate just the vote/claim/post buttons.

findings.title: Identical gate message on every tab — no tab-specific explanation of what each feature IS
findings.evidence: Switching tabs changes only the URL param (?section=bounties|bribes|gauges); the card copy 'Connect your wallet to participate' never changes. A vote-market newcomer cannot learn what Vote Incentives or Gauge Voting do, what token is used, or why they'd connect.
findings.suggestion: Per-tab gate copy: one sentence of what the section does + what connecting unlocks (e.g. 'Deposit incentives to attract gauge votes; voters claim after the epoch'). Also clarifies the bribes-UI objective, which currently has zero explanation.

findings.title: Primary RPC eth.llamarpc.com is down — repeated 521 preflight failures
findings.evidence: read_network_requests captured 6 total OPTIONS https://eth.llamarpc.com/ → 521 across both pages. No user-visible breakage observed (failover worked), but every page load pays for a dead-host round trip.
findings.suggestion: Deprioritize or health-check llamarpc in the transport list so a dead provider isn't attempted first on every load.

findings.title: Light mode: page heading and footer legal links become dark-on-dark (contrast failure)
findings.evidence: With light theme toggled, the body/background art stays dark but 'The Collection' h1 renders dark navy on near-black (barely visible in screenshot); on /community the footer disclaimer links 'Risk Disclosure · Security' render dark purple on the dark navy footer — illegible. Header bar itself turns orange while everything else stays dark, so the theme reads half-applied.
findings.suggestion: Keep heading/link foregrounds light wherever the dark art background persists in light mode, or scope the light palette to surfaces that actually lighten.

findings.title: Mascot button + tooltip overlap and occlude the 'Protocol Active' price chip
findings.evidence: Bottom-right: the Towelie mascot button sits on top of the status chip — zoom shows 'Protocol Active $0' with the rest of the price hidden under the sprite; when the tooltip ('You good? Take your time. I'm just a towel.') or the Ask-me chat opens, it also covers the chip text ('Don't show again' rendered over 'Protocol Active').
findings.suggestion: Stack the mascot above the chip (column layout) or offset the chip left so the price ($0.00004132) is always readable.

findings.title: Fast scrolling shows whole viewports of empty placeholder cells for 1s+
findings.evidence: Multiple screenshots mid-scroll show 3-6 blank dark cards at once; one post-scroll frame was almost entirely empty. After Back-navigation (scroll restored to 1500px) the surrounding cells were blank again and popped in late. Images pop in abruptly with no shimmer/blur-up.
findings.suggestion: Increase the lazy-load rootMargin so images start decoding a viewport ahead, and add a skeleton shimmer or blur-up placeholder to soften pop-in.

findings.title: Prod banner promises votes but no voting UI exists in the prod build
findings.evidence: Prod shows the purple banner 'Votes are for fun only — stored locally in your browser, not on-chain.' yet no vote control exists anywhere (DOM contains no ▲; hover overlay = title+caption only; lightbox = Prev/Close/Next). Dev HEAD cards DO show a '▲ 0' vote affordance — prod is a stale build relative to HEAD.
findings.suggestion: Redeploy prod so the vote feature matches the banner (or the banner reads as a broken promise).

findings.title: Splash screen is very long (~18-20s prod, longer on dev) with no visible skip affordance
findings.evidence: First visit ran a multi-stage art film (NAKA art → glitch → starfield → gold-burst → CLICK TO ENTER gate). My mid-splash click only advanced/entered it; nothing on screen says 'click to skip/enter' until the final frame. Good: repeat visits within the session skip it entirely, and a 'Replay splash screen' control exists.
findings.suggestion: Show a persistent 'Skip / Click to enter' hint from second 1, and consider capping total runtime ~5s. (Keep the art — it's excellent — just let users through faster.)

findings.title: Ultrawide layout: grid capped ~1150px wide on a 1912px viewport — 40% dead margins, only 3 columns
findings.evidence: Grid spans x≈375-1530 of 1912 CSS px; the 54-piece collection forces ~18 rows of scrolling while huge side margins sit empty. /community is worse: a single ~450px card floats in the page center.
findings.suggestion: Add a wider breakpoint (4-5 masonry columns at ≥1600px). For /community, let the eventual data tables/cards use the width.

findings.title: Full-resolution images served into ~374px slots; no srcset/thumbnails
findings.evidence: DOM audit: bobowelie.jpg natural 1470x2048 displayed at 374px (5.5x oversampled); art served as single .jpg files (some splash .avif reused). All 54 load eventually (0 broken images after full scroll - good).
findings.suggestion: Generate ~600px-wide thumbnails (avif/webp + srcset) for grid cells; keep originals for the lightbox.

findings.title: No search, filter, sort, or category controls for a 54-piece collection
findings.evidence: Interactive-elements dump shows only artwork buttons + global nav; no input fields exist on the page. Items mix named pieces and 'Naka #NN' card pulls with no way to browse by series.
findings.suggestion: Add a series filter (Originals / Naka deck), a sort (newest, most-voted once votes ship), and a text filter.

findings.title: Metadata sloppiness: duplicate 'Naka #7', inconsistent numbering, copy-paste captions
findings.evidence: Page text lists 'Naka #07' early and a second 'Naka #7' as the final item; numbering mixes zero-padded (#01) and bare (#1, #2) plus a '#28b'; every Naka shares the caption 'Fresh from the deck'; 'The Sword of Love' card's caption is just 'The sword of love'.
findings.suggestion: Dedupe/normalize titles and write one-line unique captions — the lore is the product here.

findings.title: Vote Incentives tab maps to ?section=bribes — naming mismatch in shareable URLs
findings.evidence: Clicking 'Vote Incentives' sets /community?section=bribes (deep links work, which is good); the param leaks internal 'bribes' naming the UI deliberately avoids.
findings.suggestion: Accept both but emit ?section=incentives for consistency.

findings.title: Grid order appears to reshuffle between visits/re-renders
findings.evidence: First load row 1 = Sword of Love / Window Watch / Sunset Beach; after scroll-to-top re-render row 1 = Sword of Love / jungle beach / zebras; after reload it changed again. Disorienting if a user wants to relocate a piece (no permalinks/anchors to items either).
findings.suggestion: Keep a stable default order (or make shuffle an explicit control) and give each piece a #anchor or /gallery/:slug route.

findings.title: Mascot chat input is tiny and pinned into the corner
findings.evidence: The 'Ask me anything…' chat opens as a ~180px-wide box at the extreme bottom-right corner with truncated intro text ('I'm ju…' while typing out); on a 1912px viewport it is nearly invisible.
findings.suggestion: Give the chat a proper min-width (~320px) panel and anchor it above the mascot, not under it.

findings.title: Page content fade-in after splash/navigation takes ~3-4s and renders text over unloaded art
findings.evidence: At T+3s after reload, the Community heading/tabs were visible at ~40% opacity over a black background; the skull background art painted ~4s later. The blank→dim→art sequence reads as jank rather than a transition.
findings.suggestion: Gate the fade-in on the hero image's onload, or use a fast (300ms) fade so content never appears half-transparent.

good: No console errors on either page across loads, tab switches, lightbox open/close, and theme toggles (verified with cleared error-only reads).
Zero broken images: all 54 gallery pieces loaded with naturalWidth > 0 after a full-page scroll audit; masonry handles mixed aspect ratios without cropping.
Honest, well-worded trust banner on /gallery ('Votes are for fun only — stored locally in your browser, not on-chain.') — exactly the right disclosure pattern.
Community tabs write deep-linkable URL params (?section=bounties/bribes/gauges) so sections are shareable/bookmarkable.
Scroll restoration works perfectly (scrollY 1500 preserved across navigate-away + Back).
Per-page document.title is correct ('Community | Tegridy Farms', 'Gallery | Tegridy Farms').
Splash plays only once per session; repeat visits go straight to content, and a deliberate 'Replay splash screen' button exists for fans of the intro — great repeat-visit behavior.
RainbowKit connect modal opens fast and clean (Phantom detected as installed, Rainbow/Base/MetaMask/WalletConnect offered) and closes with Escape; no wallet was connected during the audit.
Provider failover absorbed a fully-down primary RPC (eth.llamarpc.com 521) with no user-visible breakage.
Footer is information-rich: contract address with copy button, Etherscan/GeckoTerminal/Uniswap links, legal pages, and the 'Experimental protocol' risk disclaimer.
Accessibility basics present: artwork cards are real <button>s with descriptive aria-labels ('View artwork: The Sword of Love'), nav uses menuitem roles, mascot/replay controls are labeled.
Card hover overlay (title + caption, gradient scrim) is a tasteful, art-first detail; the Towelie mascot's rotating quips are charming and on-brand.
live:community-gallery.splashAndTransitions: Splash: first visit per session plays a multi-stage art film (NFT art pan → RGB glitch → starfield → gold light-burst → 'TEGRIDY FARMS — CLICK TO ENTER' gate) totaling ~18-20s on prod before interaction; no skip hint until the final frame (a mid-splash click advances it). Has autoplay audio with a mute toggle. Repeat visits in-session skip it entirely (good) and a labeled 'Replay splash screen (full reload)' button exists. Post-splash, page content fades in over ~3-4s and text appears before the background art loads (half-transparent jank window). Page-to-page transitions are instant SPA swaps with correct scroll restoration; gallery lazy-images pop in abruptly (no skeleton/blur-up) and fast scrolls show viewports of blank cells. The gallery lightbox enter animation is broken outright (frozen at opacity 0 — see critical finding).
live:community-gallery.consoleAndNetwork: Console: clean — zero errors/exceptions captured on /community and /gallery across reloads, tab switches, lightbox interactions, and theme toggles. Network: only failures were OPTIONS https://eth.llamarpc.com/ → HTTP 521 (Cloudflare 'web server down'), seen 6 times total across both pages (provider failover masked it from the UI). No /api/ calls observed on either page (community is fully wallet-gated; gallery is static assets). All art/splash asset requests returned 200; no 4xx/5xx/429 from the app's own origin; no notably slow calls beyond the lazy-image pop-in.

https://tegridyfarms.vercel.app/gallery (full grid scroll, lightbox, More menu, mascot chat, light/dark theme, scroll restoration)
